victor krueller.name: Victor Krueller
victor krueller.origin: Years ago, before Wilson Fisk became the Kingpin, he had a "falling out" with an associate named Victor "Kruel" Krueller. Their fight was witnessed by many people at a Pennsylvania diner. Among them were Karen Page, Foggy Nelson, Ben Urich, Glorianna O'Breen, and Kathy Malper. The diner was burned with Kruel inside. Fisk ordered his men to "burn the memories" of the witnesses. Years later, Kruel appeared to be alive and kicking. He started attacking the witnesses from that day to help him remember who tried to kill him. He attacked Ben Urich and killed Glorianna. Daredevil believed he was the reason behind these attacks and warned Kathy Malper. Kathy didn't believe him until Kruel attacked them. Once Kruel recalled another detail about the "fat man" that beat him, he escaped. Later, Daredevil confronted the only person he knew with the knowledge and the resources to attack those closest to Matt Murdock: Wilson Fisk. While Daredevil confronted Kingpin, Krueller arrived and tried to kill them both. Joining forces, Fisk and Murdock were able to kill him before he killed Foggy Nelson.

fields.notes: The Krueller saga ( - , the only Marvel comics written by " e" which is a traditional pseudonym for authors) presents an important timeline inconsistency affecting Karen and other characters. In that story, Krueller had been attacked by a young Kingpin, who was not yet the ruler of crime, and several people witnessed the event including Foggy Nelson, a law student; Karen Page, a struggling actress; and Glorianna O'Breen, who had just migrated to the US. However: Karen started pursuing a career as an actress in (1970). She had been working for Foggy Nelson's firm since (1964), where Foggy was already a lawyer - so at no moment Foggy was a law student and Karen a struggling actress at the same time. Besides, Glorianna O'Breen went to the US in (1984); by then Kingpin was already a very established mob boss (not an up-and-comer) who had clashed with Daredevil since (1981) - and had been seen as a lord of crime since (1967).

victor lillian.name: Victor Lillian
victor lillian.origin: Blistik was a misguided and self-proclaimed "protector of the quality of urban life" in New York City. Effectively a vigilante, with questionable methods of upholding "order" he came into conflict with Captain America. He attacked a group of teens for loud music and blew up a van that nearly killed pedestrians. He then went to deal with Fabian Stankiewicz who was trying to jump off the Brooklyn Bridge. Blistik was annoyed that Fabian was causing a scene and tried to get him to jump quickly. Captain America arrived and tried to save Fabian's life, which annoyed Blistik even more and tried to push Fabian but was stopped by Cap who knocked Blistik into the river. ===Civil War=== Blistik was attacking a construction site when he was again defeated by Captain America. After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative.

victor lodenko.name: Victor Lodenko
victor lodenko.origin: Victor Lodenko was a Winter Soldier victim killed in 1982, for which Barnes was convicted as the KGB claimed he had become a rogue and therefore did not carry out government orders. In fact Lodenko was a cover name while he was in fact a KGB agent working on the Red Room Program and his murder was sanctioned by Colonel Rostov.

victor mancha.name: Victor Mancha
victor mancha.origin: ===Origins=== thumb|left|200px|Marianella Mancha (Earth-616)|Marianella Mancha and Ultron constructing Victor When Ultron was defeated by Dr. Hank Pym and the West Coast Avengers, his remains were unceremoniously disposed of in a local landfill. After an undetermined amount of time, Ultron's head with an active CPU was discovered by a petty criminal and former drug mule Marianella Mancha, who superstitiously believed him to be a prophet. Marianella brought him home and the pair grew close; she even disclosed her inability to physically bear children and her inability to adopt due to her criminal past. In exchange for gathering the material he needed to construct a new body, Ultron promised to give her a child as a "reward". He began using Marianella's DNA and his cybernetics to create a cyborg. Designed with nanites, Victor's body would continue to develop until he would be virtually indistinguishable from a fully biological human. Ultron programmed false memories of a childhood into Victor, but he also encoded a deep-rooted love and admiration for superheroes. Additionally, Victor was built with latent electromagnetic abilities set to activate upon his first contact with another super-powered individual. Ultron's long-term plan involved Victor visiting New York City at the age of twenty-one, meeting the Avengers, activating his powers, and being recruited to the team as an unsuspecting sleeper agent. ===Runaways=== Victor appeared to live an uneventful life growing up in Los Angeles. His mother told him his father was a U.S. Marine that died during the Panama Invasion. Due to her superstitious beliefs Victor was forbidden from flying in planes and even had to change schools, though in actuality these were tactics to avoid metal detectors. After receiving an ominous message from a fatally wounded Heroine (Gertrude Yorkes from the the future) about the villainous Victorious, the Runaways set out to turn Victor off this evil trajectory. The Runaways confronted Victor outside of East Angeles High School where his electromagnetic power unexpectedly activated, unintentionally causing a fight that was soon clumsily broken up by the arrival of Excelsior. thumb|right|200px|Victor breaking free of Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron's control The Runaways were eventually able to explain their motivation for kidnapping Victor, but still shocked with disbelief, Victor attempted to contact his mother only to have Doctor Doom answer. Fortunately, Doctor Doom turned out to be merely a Doombot; unfortunately, this led to meeting Victor's real father, Ultron. With his secret plan failing, Ultron killed Marianella and briefly commandeered Victor. thumb|left|200px|Victor controlled by his father, Ultron (Earth-616)|Ultron Victor was able to break free of his father's programming, and Ultron was eventually destroyed by Darkhawk and Excelsior. With his mother dead and nowhere else to go, Victor joined the Runaways as a provisional member. After a month of observation, Victor was finally permitted to help in battle and single-handedly defeated Swarm. He also helped defend Karolina against Xavin, take down the Security Daemons, thwarted Dragoness, and saved Gert and Old Lace from falling off a skyscraper in New York City. However, Chase continued to distrust Victor long after the other Runaways had accepted him. Unbeknownst to Victor, his software had been hacked by Geoffrey Wilder and his New Pride, allowing them to spy on the Runaways. When it was discovered that Victor was leaking information, the other quickly turned on him. Victor was able to clear his name by reversing signal and locating the Pride. Like the others, Victor took the death of Gertrude Yorkes very hard. Victor found comfort in a physically intimate relationship with Nico, but she was very reluctant to explore the possibility of an actual relationship. ===Civil War=== thumb|right|200px|Victor working with his "brother", the Young Avengers (Earth-616)|Young Avengers' the Vision During the height of the Superhero Civil War, the Young Avengers attempted to come to the aid of the Runaways. However, both teams were bested by Marvel Boy. Additionally, due to their similar programming as Ultron progeny, Vision and Victor created intense feedback when near each other. Ultimately, Victor used this to his advantage, by channeling the energy created from the feedback at Marvel Boy. ===Post Civil-War=== When Chase bound Nico and stole the Staff of One, he was confronted by Victor. Chase exploited Victor's omnipotence paradox programming flaw before leaving to meet the Gibborim. Victor remained completely catatonic until Molly, with the help of Alex Wilder's ghost, was able to break the paradox loop. Molly and Victor then joined the other already in battle with the Gibborim and was able to rescue Nico with a Fastball Special courtesy of Molly. Upon returning to the Hostel, the Runaways were unexpectedly greeted by Iron Man and his Cape-Killers. Along with the other Runaways, Victor

fields.notes: thumb|200px|right|Victor admiring Gert's taste in movies Victor has had complicated relationships with many of the other Runaways: With their similar sense of humor and intellect, Gertrude and Victor shared some chemistry. However, Gert and Chase's relationship and Gert's death prevent anything from progressing at that time. Since their individual "resurrections", the pair have begun to explore a romantic relationship. Nico and Victor had intercourse after Gert's death, but she was very reluctant to explore the possibility of an actual relationship. Their relationship officially ended when Victor became interested in Spieler. Chase was jealous of Victor's and Gert's chemistry, intimidated by Victor's intellect, and bore a grudge at him for Victorious murdering Heroine. Chase remained suspicious of Victor long after the other Runaways had accepted him. The pair eventually fell into a playfully contentious relationship as friends. Xavin looked down on Victor for being an inferiorly designed android and often made disparaging remarks towards him and treated him as property. Molly trusted Victor easily, and the two were often paired together for outings because Molly is the only one who could take on Victor. Later, Victor began to be an older brother figure to both Molly and Klara. Victor was one of the few Runaways to develop a friendship with the Leapfrog.
fields.trivia: Before learning the true identity of his father, the Runaways postured that Victor could have been the son of Electro, Kingpin, the Leader, Norman Osborn, Magneto, Hitler, Red Skull, or even Galactus. Ultron also sent a Doombot posing as Doctor Doom to make Victor and the others believe Doom was his father. He also claimed Victor was a mutant. Although Victor appears to be in his mid to late teens, he is chronologically only a few years old. Victor was stated to be seventeen years old in . 300px|thumb|right|Victor Mancha (Earth-616)|Victor Mancha explaining that Old Lace is a Deinonychus. not a Velociraptor. It was Victor who first recognized Old Lace as a . Before this, all the Runaways (including Gert) believed Old Lace was a . Victor sleeps in the nude and his original body was apparently well endowed. Victor's mother was devoutly Catholic, and "raised" Victor in that religious faith. Until recently, Victor had never had an official codename but had received several nicknames including: Li'l Ultron, Kid Ultron, Victron, Static Cling Lad, Zapper, Calculator Kid, El Diablo Robotico, Man of La Mancha, Doom Junior, Amigo, Speak and Spell, Jinx, Señor Cyborg, Magnet Man, Energizer Bunny, Cool Magneto, Tin Man, Victorious, Junior, Terminator, Small Wonder, dorkbot, C-sleepy-O, Mandoird, Borg Queen, RoboPinocchio, Captain Deadweight, etc. He also tried out a few codenames during his time with the Avengers A.I. Squad including: Wolf-Swag, Devil Slayer, Wolf Bro, and Skull Boss. Victor claims to be a big fan of Spanish writer . De Cervante's most famous creation, the protagonist of the eponym came from a place named . Mancha is Spanish for "stain", "spot", or "mark". Doombot considered Victor his best friend.

victor neumenon.name: Victor Neumenon
victor neumenon.origin: Victor Neumenon was the assistant to Albion Crawley who followed Crawley on his expedition for the The Crossing of the Abyss. They discovered the Arachnix and were captured by them. They tried to consume Crawley but he was able to escape with the help of Victor, who was turned into a Sorrow Fly. After leaving Crawley, Sorrow Fly traveled to the Insect World. While here, he helped send the surviving egg (that would become a Radioactive Spider) to New York City. victor octavius.name: Victor Octavius
victor octavius.species: Human mutate; after being diagnosed with the bubonic plague, Victor Octavius used the blood of octopuses to cure his sickness, but also turning him into a octopus/human hybrid.
victor octavius.origin: Baron Victor Octavius was a Italian nobleman living in France who suffered from the bubonic plague. Octavius attempted to cure himself by using the blood of octopi, which worked, but also slowly transforming him into a human/octopus hybrid. Octavius had since tried to revert his transformation by experimenting on humans and 'Witchbreeds' to find a viable cure and even forcing scientist Henri Le Pym to help him by holding his shrunken wife, Janette Le Pym, hostage. In public, Octavius always kept his entire body hidden from prying eyes and always accompanied with plague doctors. After having been using the blood of his fellow colleague Hal McCoy which slowed his transformation had begun to wain, Octavius learned from Norman Osborne about the Spider and captured him in obtaining his blood for his cure. However, once Henri Le Pym completed the serum, Octavius had ultimately progressed to his complete hybrid form which drove him to madly think that he was a superior life form above humankind. As a result, Octavius turned on Pym and his underlings, and fought the Spider. Just as Octavius had the advantage, he was towered over by a giant Henri Le Pym, who had drank the vial that was used to cure Octavius and Janette's size. Octavius begged Le Pym to spare him, but was then crushed to death by Henri's giant foot.

victor prazniki.name: Victor Prazniki
victor prazniki.origin: Victor Prazniki was an extremely wealthy and influential man as leader of the Machinists' Union. He came into possession of the sword Raven's Eye, which is said to be cursed. He began getting threatening phone calls, saying that they would kill his wife and daughter if he didn't give them the sword. He hired Thor and Amora to protect them until he could get rid of it, but they were captured and he agreed to surrender the sword to what turned out to be Loki.

victor santiago.name: Victor Santiago
victor santiago.origin: Victor Santiago was a Peruvian drug lord who had his assassins attack the judge presiding over his trial in Lima's airport. The guards were killed and the judge was given a warning, the next day the judge declared a mistrial. Victor afterwards told a journalist he knew nothing about the attack and said he was donating money to each of the widows. The Punisher went to his country estate, and battled his way to the top floor where Victor was located. He made it to his room but couldn't get to Victor due to the thick bulletproof glass barrier that sled down. Punisher threatened to wait him out till he died of thirst or starvation, unless he turned himself in, provided testimony to clear an innocent woman, had her child returned to her, and gave him Eduardo one of the hitters involved in the attack. After turning himself he was released and fled to Belize. The Punisher followed him to Belize, a nation that was dealing with private drug armies, Guatemalan rebels, and the Guatemalan army. He intervened on the side of a unit of British-led Gurkhas during a three-sided firefight with the Guatemalan army and rebels, and then went with them to the archaeological camp they were defending. Victor then manipulated the Guatemalan army and rebels to ambush the British patrol, who left only a few guards back at their camp. Santiago himself led his own men in an assault on the camp. They quickly took out the guards, leaving only the Punisher to protect the archaeologists. During the firefight, the remnants of the British patrol and Guatemalan forces appeared turning it into a four way firefight. Santiago's private army was nearly annihilated and a Gurkha killed the drug lord.

victor slaughter.name: Victor Slaughter
victor slaughter.species: Human infected with a strain of pseudo vampirism
victor slaughter.origin: ===Early Life=== Victor "Vic" Slaughter served in the US Marine whose squad was on specialized assignments for the CIA. On such mission his team was sent to Central America for three years, they all died leaving Vic the soul survivor. This lead to PTSD when he returned to the States, he eventually recovered forming his own mercenary team known as the Hardcases. ===Hunt for Morbius=== Simon Stroud former CIA agent hired Vic to hunt and take down Morbius, the Living Vampire as part of his personal vendetta. The team waited at a nearby cemetery for the arrival of the pseudo-vampire. He was there to visit the grave of Martine Bancroft. They shot at him with everything they had believing they killed him, however Morbius leapt on Vic. He tried to shoot at Morbius with a more powerful explosive but did not have a chance as Morbius bit him on the neck, and broke several bones, attempting to find out who hired Slaughter. Failing at this, Morbius tossed him into an open grave and buried him alive. ===Return from the Grave=== At sunrise he dug his way out of the grave was revenge on Morbius. He was taken to the nearby St. Jude's Hospital buy Morbius in his identity of "Dr. Morgan Michaels". He was questioned by two police detectives, but he fellow unconscious and had to be taken to intensive care. He was fitted with cast to set his broken limbs. He began to change becoming pale and his body dropped drastically. When a nurse arrived to change his blood he attacked her draining her dry. He then went on a killing spree across the city. Morbius tried to stop him and pushed him in front of a train, but he survived healing from his wounds. He went to Stroud but Morbius had wiped his memory through hypnosis. He disarmed him and returned his erased memory. He revealed that he had left town after learning of his identity of "Dr. Morgan Michaels". A confrontation between Slaughter, Morbius and the Nightstalkers ended with Morbius believing Slaughter dead. He survived and was hired by the Maggia (and later the CIA) to capture a rogue CIA agent. This led him into conflict with Morbius, Spider-Man and Simon Stroud. ===The Unkillables=== left|200px|thumb A man named Winsor hired Vic to join his team of Unkillables. The teams first mission was to retrieve Harry Sikes an immortal man who was buried in the 1950s. Vic and Suicide went on a hunt for Wolverine and attacked the Mutant hero. They captured Wolverine and took him to Winsor's laboratory. Winsor allowed Vic to feed a little bit on Logan but found it difficult to digest. Vic and the team attacked Logan, but while in his gaseous form Vic was breathed in by Scavenger and trapped inside his body. Winsor's son Flip used his powers to free Vic from Scavengers body. He along with the Unkillables ate Winsor to stop the threat. The team decided to remain together forming their own mercenary crew. Slaughter later appeared fighting Gambit at the behest of Mr. Nil.

victor strange.name: Victor Strange
victor strange.species: Vampire (Human unsuccessfully resurrected with magic, including the use of the Vampiric Verses)
victor strange.origin: Victor Strange was born in Nebraska to Eugene and Beverly Strange, being the youngest brother to Donna and Stephen Strange. After the deaths of Donna and their mother, Stephen was unable to face any more tragedy and refused to visit Eugene's deathbed. A few days later, an outraged Victor confronted Stephen in his apartment over his apparent lack of grief. Following the confrontation, Victor rushed from the apartment and into the path of an oncoming car. Victor died, and a guilt-wracked Stephen placed Victor's body in cryogenic sleep, hoping that future breakthroughs could revive him. When Stephen became a sorcerer, he tried to use magic to revive his brother. He studied all sorts of books and ancient texts, but nothing seemed to work. Unbeknownst to him, he had ended up unwittingly using the Vampiric Verse, transforming Victor into a vampire. Years later, Victor's chamber failed and he woke up confused and amnesiac. Marie Laveau, who was looking for vampires to prolong her life, summoned Victor and tried to use him in her plans, but his rational side took over and he turned against her before escaping. 220px|thumb|left|As Baron Blood When his brother found him, he tried to help him, but Laveau shot him with a golden Arrow of Eros to take control of him once more, and made him steal the Darkhold for her. During this time, Laveau named her new pet vampire "Baron Blood" and had him wear a costume much like that of the original Baron Blood, John Falsworth. Nonetheless, Vic was freed by Stephen and his allies, and helped them fight the beasts that Marie Laveau released upon them. After this, Victor began a relationship with Morgana Blessing, who'd provide him with a regular supply of blood to quench his thirst, while he tried being a hero like his brother. When the original Baron Blood returned, Victor began calling himself Khiron and started hunting those he thought were criminals even if they were not committing crimes. Morgana tried to convince him that, sooner or later, he'd wind up killing an innocent, but Victor was craving for more blood and left her. When Stephen heard of this, he tracked Victor down, leading to a fight between the two that ended with Victor realizing he had almost killed an innocent man. Thinking himself too dangerous to be alive, he impaled himself with a wooden stake, ending his life. Due to the magical properties of his return, however, he returned to life some time afterwards, trapped in a mirror dimension. He conspired with Varnae to strike during the latter's attempt to conquer Earth. Victor sealed Bats, Anton, and Aleister into his former prison before inhabiting his brother's empty, vampiric body. Moments before he could turn Wong, Bats channeled the Dog God to escape. Victor was expelled and defeated before Baron Mordo took him for later use.

Marie Laveau, who was looking for vampires to prolong her life, summoned Victor and tried to use him in her plans, but his rational side took over and he turned against her before escaping. 220px|thumb|left|As Baron Blood When his brother found him, he tried to help him, but Laveau shot him with a golden Arrow of Eros to take control of him once more, and made him steal the Darkhold for her. During this time, Laveau named her new pet vampire "Baron Blood" and had him wear a costume much like that of the original Baron Blood, John Falsworth. Nonetheless, Vic was freed by Stephen and his allies, and helped them fight the beasts that Marie Laveau released upon them. After this, Victor began a relationship with Morgana Blessing, who'd provide him with a regular supply of blood to quench his thirst, while he tried being a hero like his brother. When the original Baron Blood returned, Victor began calling himself Khiron and started hunting those he thought were criminals even if they were not committing crimes. Morgana tried to convince him that, sooner or later, he'd wind up killing an innocent, but Victor was craving for more blood and left her. When Stephen heard of this, he tracked Victor down, leading to a fight between the two that ended with Victor realizing he had almost killed an innocent man. Thinking himself too dangerous to be alive, he impaled himself with a wooden stake, ending his life. Due to the magical properties of his return, however, he returned to life some time afterwards, trapped in a mirror dimension. He conspired with Varnae to strike during the latter's attempt to conquer Earth. Victor sealed Bats, Anton, and Aleister into his former prison before inhabiting his brother's empty, vampiric body. Moments before he could turn Wong, Bats channeled the Dog God to escape. Victor was expelled and defeated before Baron Mordo took him for later use.

victor vandoom.name: Victor Vandoom
victor vandoom.origin: Victor Vandoom was the great-grandson of Ludwig Vandoom, the creator of a giant wax monster. He set out to create his own monstrous creatures for his own personal gain, working from the abandoned Castle Kruger in Lichtenbad. He perfected his monster serum using the lingering traces of the formula used on Todd Ziller, the depowered American Kaiju. When Deadpool infiltrated Castle Kruger, Vandoom injected him with his new serum to test it, and let him go. On the outskirts of the castle, the monstrous Deadpool stumbled upon Red Hulk, who had been sent to Lichtenbad to retrieve Ziller, and a battle broke out due to Deadpool's inability to properly communicate. Vandoom filmed the fight with hidden cameras to use the footage to promote his creation. Shortly before Deadpool's healing factor cured him of the serum's mutation and he stopped Red Hulk from fighting, Vandoom injected Ziller with his serum in repayment for his help, turning him back into the American Kaiju. Vandoom continued observing as the American Kaiju targeted Red Hulk and Deadpool. However, his gloating over the Kaiju's prowess was cut short when Red Hulk grabbed the monster by the tail and flung him against Castle Kruger, collapsing the building and seemingly killing Vandoom in the process.

victor von doom.name: Victor von Doom
victor von doom.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|left|Victor von Doom as a child. Victor Von Doom was born in Haasenstadt, Latveria, to Cynthia and Werner von Doom. His parents were members of the Zefiro Clan, a local Romani class in Latveria who were much maligned under the rule of King Vladimir and were constantly forced to be on the run from the King's soldiers. While his father used traditional medicine and worked as a healer, Cynthia was a practitioner of sorcery. Victor has claimed that he has full recall of all his memories dating back from being in utero, and suspects that this might have something to do with his mother's practitioner of the dark arts. When Victor was four years old, Cynthia foolishly made a pact with the demon Mephisto. She gained the power to attack the King's enemies with magic, but it came at the cost of the lives of all the children in a nearby village. This horrified Cynthia, and she became hunted by the King's men and eventually slain. Found by Werner, she had him promise not to let her son learn of or use the dark arts. Cynthia was buried in an unmarked grave, and when the other members of the Zefiro began speaking poorly of Cynthia, her own articulate son spoke up in her defence, also warning the other Roma that continuing to speak poorly of her would force him to grow up to be just like his mother. Following the funeral, Werner hid the mystical artefacts of his late wife from his son in an effort to protect him. thumb|Victor at age 11 playing with Valeria. Growing up, Victor often played with a young girl named Valeria. Valeria was Doom's only friend among his people and by the age of eleven that friendship grew into love. It was during this time that the King's wife became terminally ill with cancer and so he sent his guards to collect Werner to try and cure her. Saving the king's wife was out of Werner's power, however, and she eventually died of her illness, so the King ordered Werner's death. Werner then fled the Zefiro village with his son into the Latverian alps and had to spend their night out in the elements after their horse ran off. Werner wrapped his son in his clothing leaving him exposed to the elements. Werner and Victor were found by another Romani named Boris who brought them back to the village. There on his deathbed, Werner put Victor in the care of Boris. His dying words were a warning of protection involving Victor. Furious over his father's death, Victor vowed to eventually get revenge. thumb|222px|left|Victor and his father hiding in the Latverian Alps. Boris then showed Victor his father's legacy: his collection of herbs and potions that he used to cure the ill, hoping the boy would carry on his father's craft. Searching through these meagre possessions Victor also came across the trunk containing his mother's various mystical artifacts. These he showed to Valeria, and while she feared their use, Victor then spent his years mastering the arts of both science and sorcery. One night, while Victor slept, he was visited by the 6th century mystic Morgan Le Fay. Le Fay had travelled to this era to get revenge against Victor's future self who had wronged her, but before she could kill young Victor she decided against it, wanting his future self to know why he was being punished and also to prevent the potential of altering history in a way that would ill benefit her. Eventually, Victor became a master of both science and magic and vowed to use these skill to become master of the world. This drew a wedge between hmi and Valeria, who feared that Victor was out of control, while he saw her as weak. thumb|Victor as a young adult. Victor started off by using his skills to sell various barons and lords of Latveria seemingly valuable objects, such as a violin that required no skill to play, hair salve that could cure headaches, and various other trinkets and sundries. However Von Doom usually tricked his wealthy clients, as most of the items he sold would go sour or break shortly after his departure. This earned him enmity among the ruling class of Latveria and the surrounding region. Attempts to capture Doom and execute him for his crimes were always met with failure thanks to Doom's various devices that allowed him to evade capture. One of his early forays into robotics included a robot which he had stand in for himself before a firing squad. Doom also used his mastery of both science and sorcery to protect the Zefiro people, making him their leader and protector as they tried to stay a step ahead of the King who so persecuted them. One night while Victor went for a walk away from the village he was caught by one of King Vladimir's soldiers with nothing to defend himself. With a rifle pointed in his face, Victor suddenly lunged at the soldier and strangled him to death. Victor looked the man in the eye as his life was snuffed out and the experience left him feeling horrified, believing that he had finally become his mother's son. fields.notes: In Latveria, Doom has his own holiday - Doom's Day, which is an enormous celebration. One of Doctor Doom's traits that often makes him stand out is his tendency to refer to himself in third person. Because of his status as ruler of Latveria, Doom typically has diplomatic immunity. This is perhaps his greatest asset, as any attempt to kill him would be a breach of international law - It has been used to prevent his death at the hands of the Fantastic Four, and resulted in Captain America acting as Doom's escort/bodyguard whilst he was making a diplomatic visit to America. Doom has learned magic from several powerful individuals, including Doctor Strange and Morgan Le Fay. Doom has also taken apprentices of his own, such as Layla Miller. A limited series titled was written by Nick Spencer with artist Becky Cloonan before being cancelled.
fields.trivia: In one retcon, the scar that Doom originally received from the explosion of his arcane device was, while large, not horribly disfiguring. In his eagerness to assume his masked persona, he donned the faceplate of his first suit of armor while the metal was still smoking from the forge. The burns he suffered from this act were thought to have made him truly hideous. However, this was later itself retconned in the series . The original story of his scar was that the explosion of his demonic portal actually did cause a hideous disfiguring scar, and to suit his own hubris, he donned the infamous mask. After the Secret Wars, the Beyonder appeared in , where he explained that he had pulled Doom from a different time. He then rectified the situation by reordering Doom's appearances to fit the time-stream. Doom is allegedly a user of the FaceSpace social network, and friend to Nuwa. Doctor Doom made a cameo appearance in the pages of DC's . In the scene, Doom and Wolverine are executed by a super villain team known as the . The scene was written by Grant Morrison. In , Doom states he has studied under one of Dracula's greatest enemies. This does not refer to Abraham van Helsing but rather Cagliostro. Doom has also shown that he did not recognize Dracula's title of Count. Doom killed his first person at the age of sixteen, however it was in self-defense. Doom states that his self-awareness began when he was within his mother's womb. Doom theorized that his mother's contact with demons is what made this possible, further stating that their "... touch opened [his] mind too clearly and too early". Benjamin Grimm may have been responsible for the accident that disfigured Doom, saying that he had tampered with Doom's machine some time before the accident. Doom owns three , having previously possessed four, but ordered one to be destroyed merely because it displeased him. thumb|right|Stamp Vol 1 84 "A" Series Marvel Value Stamps Dr. Doom was featured on stamp Vol 1 84 of the Marvel Value Stamps "A" series. It was published in in May, 1975. Latveria has its own version of ' song " ", which replaces "love" for "Doom." Even though Doom was expelled from college before finishing his only known higher studies, he claims to possess multiple doctorates. Also, he began calling himself "Doctor Doom" before completing any higher education, as he took on the name immediately after hearing "Doctor Reed Richards" on the news while still in the Himalayas. Doom has splinters of the True Cross which was said to be the Cross where Jesus Christ was crucified. Doom holds these stakes in his armor in case he comes across Dracula. Doom has a shrine wall to Ziggy Pig and Silly Seal. Victor appears to see some of himself in Jesus, since he considers himself a savior, and has quoted him during a confrontation with Mephisto. Doom believes that mutants are not the next step in humanity's evolution, but instead serve to force the humans to evolve. When Doom took over Strange Academy, he installed an "Anti-Reed Society." Famous British-American rapper fashioned his on-stage persona after Doctor Doom. He featured the character on the cover of his 1999 debut solo album . His controversial body doubles were even referred to as "Doombots."

victor von doom clone.name: Victor von Doom (Clone)
victor von doom clone.origin: ===Creation=== Seeking both to satisfy an archaic Latverian law requiring dictators to abdicate after a set term and to improve his standing with the United Nations, Doctor Doom devised a scheme in which he would publicly step down in favor of a supposed son while secretly maintaining control. He instructed his scientist Gert Hauptmann to grow a genetic duplicate of himself, granting the clone at least some of his memories so that he could convincingly impersonate Doom's heir as Victor von Doom II. To support this plan and enable a global power grab, Doom also established Cynthian Associates as a United States based research front and installed the clone there to oversee a project to develop a sophisticated mind-control device capable of swaying the United Nations. ===Cynthian Associates=== At a time when the Fantastic Four had disbanded after Reed Richards lost his stretching powers and felt he could no longer lead the team, Reed accepted a position at Cynthian Associates, unaware of Doom's involvement. From a hidden command center, Doom's clone monitored Richards via remote systems as Reed quickly solved problems that had baffled Doom's prior hires, furthering the development of the mind-control device that would be used against the United Nations. Under the clone's supervision, Hauptmann deployed Doom's Hypno-Persuader to brainwash Reed, turning him into the helmeted costumed figure known as the Invincible Man. Armed with advanced illusions and technology provided by Doom, the Invincible Man tracked down and defeated the scattered Fantastic Four members and delivered them to a Doom-controlled mansion in upstate New York, reassembling the team on Doom's terms. There the clone first revealed himself openly to the captive heroes, exposed that Reed had been their attacker, restored Reed's mind, and had all four imprisoned as raw material for Doom's looming power-transfer experiment. Recognising that Doom required Reed's elastic abilities to be present and active for the transfer, the clone participated in a plan to send Richards into an unshielded spacecraft to re-expose him to cosmic radiation and reawaken his powers. During the flight, Reed was attacked by the Red Ghost, but survived a crash and was recovered by S.H.I.E.L.D., finally deducing Doom's hand behind Cynthian Associates and preparing to confront him. ===Heir of Latveria=== While Reed regrouped with his teammates, Doom brought his clone to Latveria and introduced Victor von Doom II to the Fantastic Four and the Latverian public as his long-hidden son and chosen successor to the Latverian throne. This carefully staged revelation supported Doom's claim that he would soon step aside in accordance with Latverian law while still ensuring that his apparent heir would be entirely loyal to him. In Castle Doom, Doom had the Fantastic Four captured and placed in containment globes attached to a massive transference machine, positioning the clone in a focal harness so that he could receive their combined powers. Doom activated the device intending to strip the team of their abilities and create a new superhuman monarch with all their strengths. ===Flawed transference and rebellion=== Unbeknownst to Doom, Reed had prepared a micro-feedback system in his belt specifically to disrupt any attempt to tamper with his powers. When the transference machine came online, the feedback sabotaged the process so that the Fantastic Four retained their abilities while the clone still absorbed a partial, unstable version of their powers. At the same time, Doom seized Alicia Masters as a hostage to force the heroes to surrender, then proceeded with a formal coronation in which he publicly crowned the clone as Victor von Doom II, heir to Latveria. During the ceremony, resistance leader Zorba Fortunov and the Latverian underground stormed the hall and exposed the supposed prince as a clone, revealing Doom's deception before the gathered court. thumb|left|Dr Doom kills his clone Outraged, Doom unleashed his Omni-Bots against the rebels and the Fantastic Four even as the flawed transference completed, transforming the clone into a rocky hybrid form somewhere between Doom and the Thing. The change horrified the clone but also broke Doom's psychological hold, allowing him to recognise Doom's manipulations of his people and the world. Now wielding a diminished version of the Fantastic Four's combined powers, the clone chose to side with the Latverian rebels and the Fantastic Four against his "father," confronting Doom in open battle in the throne room. He used stretching limbs, flame projection, force fields, and his enhanced strength against Doom in a personal duel, but Doom, enraged at this perceived betrayal and the loss of his handsome features, eventually activated the full output of his armor's electromagnetic systems at close range, killing the clone. ===Aftermath=== Doom furiously blamed the Fantastic Four for forcing him to slay his "son" even as their conflict and Zorba's

He instructed his scientist Gert Hauptmann to grow a genetic duplicate of himself, granting the clone at least some of his memories so that he could convincingly impersonate Doom's heir as Victor von Doom II. To support this plan and enable a global power grab, Doom also established Cynthian Associates as a United States based research front and installed the clone there to oversee a project to develop a sophisticated mind-control device capable of swaying the United Nations. ===Cynthian Associates=== At a time when the Fantastic Four had disbanded after Reed Richards lost his stretching powers and felt he could no longer lead the team, Reed accepted a position at Cynthian Associates, unaware of Doom's involvement. victor von doom paper memory.name: Victor von Doom (Paper Memory)
victor von doom paper memory.origin: This Doctor Doom was unwittingly created by Gwenpool from the recollections she possessed of the real Doom. In the Gutter Space, Gwen had noticed that the remaining page count for her comic book series was low, so in an attempt to become relevant and prolong her series' lifespan, she set out to kill Doom, who had turned a new leaf and was going by the alias of Iron Man. After luring Doom into a fight, Gwen was disgruntled in seeing he was now a good guy, as it represented a wrench in her plans. When she sliced him with a sword, from his wound this "paper memory" of Doctor Doom magically emerged. Gwenpool attempted to exile him into the Gutter Space, but as a master of magic, he found his way back quickly. Doom resumed the fight, and overpowered Gwen. While she was trying to escape, Doom teleported both of them to the Gutter Space. The real Doom appeared soon after, having recovered from his magical wound, and destroyed his duplicate swiftly, revealing in the process that its interior was made up of nothing but paper.

victoria lady.name: Victoria (Lady)
victoria lady.origin: Victoria was a resident of Erewhon, a hidden settlement in the South American jungle established as a refuge for criminals and fugitives from the law. When the Punisher was lured to Erewhon by its criminal inhabitants, Victoria was present at the local bar alongside Oswald Zinn, Gottlieb, and several other criminals. She was instructed to get Harvey Long a beer when he arrived in the village, and later became involved in the plan to use Wolverine as a "dancing bear" for the settlement's amusement. After Wolverine entered the bar looking for Harvey, Victoria attempted to gain his confidence. She told him that she knew where Harvey Long was and asked him to return that night so she could tell him what she knew. Before he left, she kissed him on the cheek and asked him to come back. Victoria subsequently met Wolverine again and secretly asked him to help her escape Erewhon. When he refused, she told him that Harvey Long was dead. Gottlieb witnessed their departure and accused Victoria of breaking Erewhon's sacred laws, declaring that he could therefore do whatever he wished with her. Victoria continued fleeing through the jungle with Wolverine, who eventually decided to help her escape. When the sound of gunfire erupted from Erewhon, Wolverine initially returned to help the Punisher. Victoria admitted that the entire situation had been a trap designed to lure Castle into Erewhon and that Wolverine had also been drawn into it. She pleaded with him not to leave her, warning that the others would kill her. Victoria then attempted to convince Wolverine to stay with her, offering him love and a future outside Erewhon and suggesting that his attachment to the Punisher was the only life he was suited for. However, they were ambushed by O'Higgins and several other criminals. While the men opened fire on Wolverine, O'Higgins seized Victoria. Victoria begged O'Higgins to let her go, claiming that she had never caused him trouble and that she had always had a soft spot for him. O'Higgins responded that he had a soft spot for her as well, before shooting her in the chest. Despite her mortal wound, Victoria survived long enough to see Wolverine break free and kill the men who had attacked them. As she lay dying, she told him that when she first saw him, she believed he would be the man capable of taking her away from Erewhon and bringing her home. Wolverine assured her that she had not been wrong. Victoria subsequently died in Wolverine's arms.

victoria anderson.name: Victoria Anderson
victoria anderson.origin: Victoria Anderson was the granddaughter of Professor Phineas T. Horton, the scientist responsible for creating the original Human Torch. She attended Pennsylvania State University, where she studied robotic engineering as a condition of an inheritance left by her grandfather. Although Victoria struggled with her studies, Horton had also bequeathed her a necklace containing a Solar Gem, a device connected to his research into artificial intelligence. While attending a lecture, Victoria was unknowingly observed through a surveillance camera by the Gremlin, a rogue synthezoid developed from technology stolen from Horton. The Gremlin subsequently hijacked an aircraft and traveled to Pennsylvania in pursuit of her. During a party, Victoria encountered a fellow student named Dave, who attempted to make advances toward her. Shortly afterward, she was approached by the Vision, whose damaged appearance frightened her. Victoria initially fled but was persuaded to listen to him by Derek Hoffman, a young boy accompanying the android. Vision explained his connection to Horton and showed Victoria photographs of her grandfather's research. When the Solar Gem embedded in Vision's forehead reacted with Victoria's necklace, the devices activated a prerecorded holographic message from Horton. The recording revealed that a prototype Solar Gem had been stolen by a German spy before World War II and used to develop the Gremlins, artificial beings responsible for sabotaging Allied aircraft. Horton had subsequently attempted to eliminate the machines using the Human Torch, but their leader survived. He had left the recording to help Victoria and Vision destroy the Gremlin should it return. Their meeting was interrupted when Victoria became frightened by Vision's behavior and fled. She attempted to escape in her car, but the Gremlin seized control of the vehicle, transporting her and Derek to a nearby Air Force base. There, they discovered that the Gremlin had taken control of the body of Derek's father, Steve Hoffman, and commandeered military equipment to confront Vision. During the ensuing confrontation, the Gremlin captured Victoria and brought her aboard a B-52 Stratofortress. It explained that its programming was intended to spread fear and destruction, despite possessing the potential to benefit humanity. Victoria challenged its reasoning, arguing that her grandfather would never have approved of its actions and that the Gremlin represented a failed experiment. After Vision freed Steve Hoffman from the Gremlin's control, Victoria devised a plan to defeat the rogue machine. She suggested allowing the Gremlin to assimilate Vision, believing his internal defenses could destroy it. When the Gremlin attempted to merge with Vision, the android's immune system attacked the invading machine. Vision then altered his density, trapping the Gremlin within his body until it was destroyed. The remaining prototype Solar Gem was subsequently destroyed by Vision to prevent the Gremlin's return. Following the confrontation, Victoria thanked Vision for his assistance and acknowledged that her grandfather had ultimately wanted his inventions to benefit humanity. She recognized that Vision had succeeded where Horton had failed by preventing the Gremlin from causing further destruction. When Vision explained that he needed to return to his friends, Victoria encouraged him to remain in contact. She also reminded him that, through their shared connection to Horton, they could consider themselves family. Vision accepted her sentiment and departed with a renewed sense of belonging.

victoria bentley.name: Victoria Bentley
victoria bentley.origin: Victoria Bentley was the daughter of a wealthy professor (and secretly, a sorcerer), Sir Clive Bentley, and an unknown mother. When her dead father was impersonated by Baron Mordo to call upon Doctor Strange, Strange arrived to investigate. He confronted Mordo, who had laid a vapor trap. Strange was able to summon Victoria to help. Mordo noticed her potential and claimed Victoria would be a threat if she ever learned to use it. Strange defeated Mordo, and told Victoria to lead whatever life she deemed fit. He decided against taking her as an apprentice, as Mordo would certainly attack again. Much later, the Living Tribunal sent Dr. Strange on a quest to restore balance to the reality: Strange had unwillingly released a great amount of evil magic power, so that many potential wizards were discovering great power and using it for crimes. Victoria Bentley, her will bended by the circumstances and her memory fuzzy, became one of those evil sorcerers. The sorcerers gathered as a team, the Circle Sinister, and released Mordo from an extra-dimensional bondage so that he could lead them, while Strange was doing his best to prevent that. However, Strange failed in his quest and Mordo exiled him to a different dimension ruled by Nebulos, Lord of the Planets Perilous. fields.notes: There is some confusion regarding her relationship to Sir Clive Bentley. In her first appearance, Victoria and Baron Mordo both stated that she was the daughter of Lord Bentley who had died ten years earlier. Doctor Strange seems to have assumed that they were referring to his old friend, Sir Clive Bentley. Years later, while speaking to Victoria, Catherwood stated that Sir Clive had always been pleased that his niece displayed strong latent occult power. The fact that Victoria did not correct him implies that Sir Clive was actually her uncle instead.

victoria creed.name: Victoria Creed
victoria creed.origin: After Victoria Creed's eldest son Luther was killed by her second son Victor, Victor was locked up in the family cellar. But one day Victor escaped, murdered his father (who had been treating Victor poorly in his captivity) and ran away from home. In later years, Victor told people that he had killed his mother as well, but he in fact hid her away and provided a life of luxury for her for years, visiting her every other week and bringing her expensive gifts. Eventually, Victoria developed cancer, so Victor took her to the most expensive nursing home in the country. She was killed a few years later by a member of the Red Right Hand whose husband Victor had murdered.

victoria grail.name: Victoria Grail
victoria grail.origin: ===Early Life=== Dr. Victoria Grail became suspicious of Dr. Arthur Harrow who was a selected candidate for the Nobel Prize in medicine for his work in the field of pain theory. She did not believe he only carried out limited research on animals. Dr. Grail raised an objection to his nomination when she traced documents relating to secret experiments by scientists in Auschwitz-Birkenau back to Harrow. The documents had been ordered to be destroyed by the Nuremberg Tribunal but had mysteriously disappeared, thanks to the group known as O.M.N.I.U.M.. Despite allegedly being in Mexico to research the jaguar and armadillo, Dr. Grail was certain that Dr. Harrow was carrying on the Auschwitz experiments and was sent by the Nobel Committee to interview him and report back to Stockholm. ===Moon Knight=== 300px|left|thumb|Moon Knight's Vision Marc Spector was driving when the Priests of Khonshu appeared to him, causing him to smash his automobile and sending him mental visions of Dr. Harrow, one of his subjects, Dr. Grail, and the pyramid. O.M.N.I.U.M. was alerted to Dr. Grail being in Yucatan and dispatched agents to apprehend her. At knife point they pushed her into a van, but the kidnapping was spotted by Marc, who quickly transformed into Moon Knight and freed her. Dr. Grail was dismissive of Moon Knight at first, but when he asked her about a scarred man, she understood they were both looking for the same man. Moon Knight and Dr. Grail, found his lab and Dr. Harrow saw them and set a jaguar on them. Moon Knight took out the cat with ease by throwing it against a wall and shocking it. They found a false wall and knocked it in with a desk, revealing steps leading down to the lab. His patients surrounded the pair, and he ordered them to kill them. Moon Knight was warned by Dr. Grail, not to hurt the innocent laborers, yet even his most powerful fists had little effect on them. Moon Knight accidently broke the arm of one of the subjects, who never noticed the injury. Moon Knight realised he couldn't defeat them without causing substantial damage, so he chose to flee. He was able to yank the strong steel door from its hinges, allowing him and Dr. Grail, to flee the pyramid. Dr. Harrow escaped in a helicopter, as they through an incendiary at them. Unbeknownst to Dr. Gail, Harrow would continue in Paraguay.

victoria hand.name: Victoria Hand
victoria hand.origin: ===S.H.I.E.L.D.=== Three years before the Skrull Invasion, Victoria Hand was an accountant for S.H.I.E.L.D., in a relationship with another agent named Isabelle. Victoria was determined to send a letter informing Director Nick Fury how he was mishandling the War on Terror. Isabelle implored Victoria not to send the letter but Victoria did anyway and was transferred immediately to Portland, Oregon. As a result, Isabelle, furious that she did not listen to her, ended their relationship. ===H.A.M.M.E.R.=== In the aftermath of the Secret Invasion, Norman Osborn rose to power and picked Victoria as his deputy director for her hawkish positions regarding anti-terrorism. When Norman transformed S.H.I.E.L.D. into H.A.M.M.E.R. Victoria was immediately tasked with ferreting out any S.H.I.E.L.D. agents loyal to Nick Fury, Tony Stark, or Captain America. However, she was unable to eliminate everyone, as a number of double agents were working for Fury. When she asked what "H.A.M.M.E.R." stood for, Osborn told her to think up something for the acronym. left|thumb|250px Victoria was witness to all the illegal and unethical dealings that Osborn was doing, like shooting down a plane to see how powerful Pepper Potts's suit was. They even tried to hunt down Iron Man as public enemy number one. H.A.M.M.E.R. tracked them to Russia. Victoria later informed Osborn that they had apprehended Maria Hill. On the Helicarrier, Victoria gave the order to dissect the Crimson Dynamo they recovered from Stark's hideout. But apparently, the real Madame Masque was in it; Victoria was horrified by her disfigured face. In fact, Pepper had disguised herself as Madame Masque, freeing Black Widow and Hill and revealing that she had an escape plan. Already, her Rescue armor had uploaded a virus to the H.A.M.M.E.R. mainframe, taking control of all the armors on the Helicarrier. In Avengers Tower, the doctors had reported to Victoria Hand that Madame Masque had suffered severe trauma after being locked inside the Crimson Dynamo suit. Realizing that the Madame Masque walking around was a fake, Hand ordered the building into lock-down to prevent the impostor from escaping before Osborn found out. Meanwhile, Pepper Potts, Black Widow, and Maria Hill were attempting to sneak out, with Potts disguised as Masque escorting prisoners. Also, her Rescue suit reported that H.A.M.M.E.R. hadn't cracked the Stark drive's encryption. Unfortunately, as the three women attempted to leave through the lobby, they found a brigade of H.A.M.M.E.R. troops waiting for them. Victoria, under Osborn's direction, conspired with criminals like Doctor Doom for personal power, defrauding the American administration, etc. Together they also recruited their own superhero strike team dubbed the Dark Avengers. Victoria, under orders from Osborn, recruited a new band of criminals to join the Thunderbolts. ===War Machine=== Osborn and Victoria learned of the fiasco in Aqiria. Enraged over the sudden turn of events, he decided to implement "Plan B". They send the Dark Avenger, Ares, to Aqiria. The word came back they had located Ultimo's head and end up releasing a virus. They must now try and contain the virus. Watching this on a viewscreen from Avengers Tower, the Iron Patriot told Victoria Hand to cancel his appointments for the day. All of these crimes were exposed to the public at large, though Osborn considered it minor. He and his troops then destroyed the giant War Machine armor before taking Rhodey into custody, preparing to place him on trial for war crimes. War Machine had exposed multiple examples of corruption around the country. However, he was still put on trial for treason and crimes against humanity, in a plan arranged by Osborn and Victoria to distract the public from the persecution of the Bainesville Ten. At a press conference arranged by Victoria, Osborn told the world that he had authorized the attack on Rhodey's prison, claiming that H.A.M.M.E.R. agents liberated the "real" Rhodey and that the cyborg Rhodey was a fake. He promised a pardon of all charges. Victoria was seen escorting Osborn, and they announced that in light of recent events, he was closing down Camp Hammond, allowing the angry citizens to ransack the place. He promised to reorganize the Initiative. Gauntlet demanded to know if anything is done about rescuing the Shadow Initiative. Osborn promised that he would get them home safe. However, he had no idea what Gauntlet was talking about and had Victoria Hand find out. Osborn was traveling along Sixth Avenue in his limo, communicating with Victoria Hand via hologram. fields.history: ===S.H.I.E.L.D.=== Three years before the Skrull Invasion, Victoria Hand was an accountant for S.H.I.E.L.D., in a relationship with another agent named Isabelle. Victoria was determined to send a letter informing Director Nick Fury how he was mishandling the War on Terror. Isabelle implored Victoria not to send the letter but Victoria did anyway and was transferred immediately to Portland, Oregon. As a result, Isabelle, furious that she did not listen to her, ended their relationship. ===H.A.M.M.E.R.=== In the aftermath of the Secret Invasion, Norman Osborn rose to power and picked Victoria as his deputy director for her hawkish positions regarding anti-terrorism. When Norman transformed S.H.I.E.L.D. into H.A.M.M.E.R. Victoria was immediately tasked with ferreting out any S.H.I.E.L.D. agents loyal to Nick Fury, Tony Stark, or Captain America. However, she was unable to eliminate everyone, as a number of double agents were working for Fury. When she asked what "H.A.M.M.E.R." stood for, Osborn told her to think up something for the acronym. left|thumb|250px Victoria was witness to all the illegal and unethical dealings that Osborn was doing, like shooting down a plane to see how powerful Pepper Potts's suit was. They even tried to hunt down Iron Man as public enemy number one. H.A.M.M.E.R. tracked them to Russia. Victoria later informed Osborn that they had apprehended Maria Hill. On the Helicarrier, Victoria gave the order to dissect the Crimson Dynamo they recovered from Stark's hideout. But apparently, the real Madame Masque was in it; Victoria was horrified by her disfigured face. In fact, Pepper had disguised herself as Madame Masque, freeing Black Widow and Hill and revealing that she had an escape plan. Already, her Rescue armor had uploaded a virus to the H.A.M.M.E.R. mainframe, taking control of all the armors on the Helicarrier. In Avengers Tower, the doctors had reported to Victoria Hand that Madame Masque had suffered severe trauma after being locked inside the Crimson Dynamo suit. Realizing that the Madame Masque walking around was a fake, Hand ordered the building into lock-down to prevent the impostor from escaping before Osborn found out. Meanwhile, Pepper Potts, Black Widow, and Maria Hill were attempting to sneak out, with Potts disguised as Masque escorting prisoners. Also, her Rescue suit reported that H.A.M.M.E.R. hadn't cracked the Stark drive's encryption. Unfortunately, as the three women attempted to leave through the lobby, they found a brigade of H.A.M.M.E.R. troops waiting for them. Victoria, under Osborn's direction, conspired with criminals like Doctor Doom for personal power, defrauding the American administration, etc. Together they also recruited their own superhero strike team dubbed the Dark Avengers. Victoria, under orders from Osborn, recruited a new band of criminals to join the Thunderbolts. ===War Machine=== Osborn and Victoria learned of the fiasco in Aqiria. Enraged over the sudden turn of events, he decided to implement "Plan B". They send the Dark Avenger, Ares, to Aqiria. The word came back they had located Ultimo's head and end up releasing a virus. They must now try and contain the virus. Watching this on a viewscreen from Avengers Tower, the Iron Patriot told Victoria Hand to cancel his appointments for the day. All of these crimes were exposed to the public at large, though Osborn considered it minor. He and his troops then destroyed the giant War Machine armor before taking Rhodey into custody, preparing to place him on trial for war crimes. War Machine had exposed multiple examples of corruption around the country. However, he was still put on trial for treason and crimes against humanity, in a plan arranged by Osborn and Victoria to distract the public from the persecution of the Bainesville Ten. At a press conference arranged by Victoria, Osborn told the world that he had authorized the attack on Rhodey's prison, claiming that H.A.M.M.E.R. agents liberated the "real" Rhodey and that the cyborg Rhodey was a fake. He promised a pardon of all charges. Victoria was seen escorting Osborn, and they announced that in light of recent events, he was closing down Camp Hammond, allowing the angry citizens to ransack the place. He promised to reorganize the Initiative. Gauntlet demanded to know if anything is done about rescuing the Shadow Initiative. Osborn promised that he would get them home safe. Then suddenly, the roof was ripped off by none other Spider-Man, who wraps his webs around Osborn and drags him away before beating the stuffing out of him. right|thumb|200px Spider-Woman later interrupted a meeting at Avengers Tower, popping up right where Victoria and Dark Avengers were, and they attacked and restrained her, believing her to be a Skrull. victoria montesi.origin: ===Family Origin === Victoria Montesi was the apparent daughter of Vittorio Montesi, a priest assigned to work in the Occult Archives in Vatican City. The Montesi priests were given special permission to marry and have children (a papal decree by Pope Eugene III in the 12th century AD) due to their strong resistance to the corruption of the Darkhold, a collection of scrolls (later bound together by the church and given the moniker "The Book of Sins") penned by the Elder God, Chthon. The Montesi family was instrumental in finding what came to be known as the Montesi Formula, a page in the Darkhold which could destroy all vampires. Her father was sterile, but judging that an heir was needed more than ever to continue the family's fight against evil, he gave in to the corruption of the Darkhold and made a bargain with Chthon for a daughter, using a "spell of fertility" from the Darkhold. Instead of impregnating her mother with Vittorio Montesi's seed, Chthon used the spell to birth his own daughter into the world. Victoria consequently sensed the Darkhold pages being used, as she was one with their power. Chthon's plan was to use her as a means to be reborn into Earth's dimension and make a mockery of her family's mission. ===Early Life=== She grew up in Italy unaware of her true nature. She rejected her father's teachings about the Church and the Darkhold, while he in turn rejected her for being a woman and a lesbian, unfit in his eyes to carry on the Montesi name. Vicki became a doctor, but faced further discrimination for being a "mongrel" with an American mother. Assassins were sent by Lilith (Mother of Demons) to kill her, for Victoria was one of the fated Nine who would oppose Lilith. Victoria's lover Nash Salvato was seriously wounded in a bomb blast meant for Victoria, leaving her paralyzed for life. After her own injuries, Vicki found she experienced visions of the Darkhold whenever its pages were being used. Realizing her father's teachings were true, she decided to oppose the Darkhold. thumb|left ===Darkhold Redeemers=== Victoria formed the Darkhold Redeemers with Louise Hastings and bodyguard Sam Buchanan. They were further assisted by Modred the Mystic during his periods of clarity. However, they were unhappy with his self-centered goals and moments of being untrustworthy. thumb|right Victoria eventually learned the facts that she was not a Montesi, her father being sterile, and her true origin as the Daughter of Chthon. Worse still, when Lilith and her Lilin attacked, Victoria suddenly realized she was pregnant. Doctor Strange deduced that this was Chthon's plan all along, to be reborn on Earth. Strange placed Victoria into stasis in order to prevent her pregnancy from coming to full term. Chthon's forces came for Victoria and brought her out of stasis. She began to deliver the baby. However, by attempting to take the form of Victoria's baby Chthon left himself vulnerable. Doctor Strange was able to stop the powerful Elder God, showing him that there was purity within even Victoria, a being made from his dark essence. The Midwife also assisted Strange as her duty to preserve life was greater than serving Chthon. ===Children of the Midnight Sun=== Now able to live a normal life, Victoria was believed to have returned to Italy. At some point Victoria joined the Children of the Midnight Sun, an organization dedicated to opposing the Darkhold Cult. When the cult attacked a village in Punjab, India, Victoria rescued a young boy named Yuvraj Singh, who became her close friend and ally for several decades. When she received word that the Darkhold had resurfaced and been acquired by the symbiote-powered serial killer Carnage, who had been altered and empowered by it. Getting in touch with Claire Dixon, the FBI agent formerly in charge of the operation to capture Carnage, Victoria offered to sponsor her team's efforts. When Claire was captured by Carnage and bonded to a Darkhold-corrupted symbiote, Victoria assumed direct leadership of the team, though the other members expressed doubts over her mysterious past. The team was soon joined by Jubulile van Scotter, a young woman who assisted Kasady on her boat when she found him adrift, unaware he was a homicidal lunatic. Jubulile had also been merged to a symbiote in a failed attempt from Carnage to control her before she escaped from him. Jubulile's symbiote also caused her to share a psychic bond with Carnage. Montesi's team finally located Carnage after the maniac delved deep into a mysterious uncharted island. Unfortunately, they arrived too late, as Carnage had already reached an ancient temple where he started a ritual to summon Chthon. Armed with her own symbiote, the Toxin symbiote from Brock, and the Raze symbiote from Dixon, Jubulile confronted Chthon when he arrived. Montesi retrieved the Darkhold from Carnage and used it to further empower Jubulile with the psychic energies of the entire world. This final power-up allowed Jubulile to banish Chtho

victoria murdock.name: Victoria Murdock
victoria murdock.origin: The villainess known as the Asbestos Lady hated the original Human Torch. With every intention of doing battle with the Torch, she designed for herself a costume made from asbestos, which essentially made her immune to fire while wearing it. Eventually, the Asbestos Lady heard about several advancements in "asbestos science" developed by Fred Raymond, and wished to have them for herself. To this end, she tried to force Fred into joining her growing gang, but the Human Torch had been watching Raymond's home in case such an attack took place. After she was repelled by the Torch, the Asbestos Lady decided to bump off the Raymond family as revenge. She arranged a train wreck that resulted in the death of all on board except for youngest Raymond, Thomas, who was apparently immune to the ensuing fire. Intrigued, the Asbestos Lady kept an eye on the youth after he joined a circus act (taking advantage of his immunity to fire), but she was again waylaid by the Human Torch who defeated her by melting her boots to the asphalt road. Some time later in 1947, the Asbestos Lady's twin brother Killer Murdock was brought to justice by the Human Torch and Toro, now a crime-fighting duo; Murdock was executed for his crimes. Asbestos Lady became determined to wipe the two heroes out. In her first attempt, she gathered her brother's old gang to try and eliminate the heroes but the plan failed, although Asbestos Lady managed to escape. She later lured the vacationing heroes into a trap where she tried to drown them in a river with an asbestos-lined net. Thinking her foes dead, Asbestos Lady and her gang started a crime spree until she was finally apprehended by the Torch and Toro for attempting to rob the gold stored at Fort Wright. Asbestos Lady was apprehended and locked away in prison, vowing to get revenge against the Torch and Toro. She later escaped from jail and was used as a pawn of the Organizers, an agency that funded supervillains in order to keep American super heroes busy in the United States and out of world affairs. In the years that followed, Murdock learned that she developed cancer due to her constant exposure to asbestos. Although her final fate is unknown, it is presumed that she succumbed to the disease.

fields.notes: Asbestos Lady has a peculiar continuity. Her first appearance was in , however her original origin story was depicted in published a month later, which explained her motivations for going up against the Human Torch and Toro. The character only had a few minor appearances before appearing again in where it was retconned that she was active as Asbestos Lady as far back as the early 1940s prior to the Human Torch and Toro becoming partners. There's no known connection of Asbestos Man with Asbestos Lady, despite the similarity in their noms de guerre. According to , Victoria Murdock may be a distant relative of Matt Murdock, aka Daredevil. However, that connection has never been mentioned in a story or any other reference work.

victoria snow.name: Victoria Snow
victoria snow.origin: Victoria Snow was a former employee of Stark Industries and ex-girlfriend of Whiplash. victoria star.name: Victoria Star
victoria star.origin: ===Early Years=== Victoria Star was born to a wealthy Texas oil baron, Remington Star, who indulged in amateur rodeo performance. He encouraged her goal of becoming a professional sharp-shooter in the rodeo. He used his wealth to provider her with special six-shooters that fired paralysis pellets in the form of stars. During her career, she met Texas Twister and the two devised an act together. Her father's team of scientists designed jet-boots that would allow her to maintain stability while in one of Twister's cyclones. The duo became a great act and developed a romantic relationship. Star and Twister intercepted a message for the Avengers from Rick Jones. He had been captured by the Corruptor who was using the Hulk. Star and Twister were joined by other heroes from the Southwest: Firebird, Phantom Rider, and Red Wolf. The team was unable to defeat the Hulk but were able to stop the Corruptor. Twister suggested the five of them form a team: the Rangers. Shooting star attended the Grandmaster Contest of Champions, and later celebrated the Hulk's presidential pardon. At some point, Star's identity was taken over by Riglevio, a demon in the employ of Master Pandemonium. Pandemonium manipulated the Rangers into confront the West Coast Avengers. During the battle, the demon was revealed and captured. It claimed to always have been Shooting Star; there had never been a human named Victoria Star. Twister demonstrated little concern at first, but left to begin a search for the real Victoria. Twister soon returned to the Avengers West Compound who demanded to see the still-captive demon. Twister explained that the demon had revealed itself to him months ago who made a pact to enhance Twister's powers in exchange for his soul. Twister expressed regret and the demon possessed Shooting Star instead of him. The demon cast a spell on Twister to prevent him from telling anyone about the possession. Twister had been secretly studying the occult in order to find a way to exorcise the demon. The demon possessed Twister and the freed Star teamed with Hawkeye to battle the demon-Twister. Star, having been possessed, threatened to kill the demon rather than allowing Twister to be controlled as she was. The demon left Twister and inhabited itself in a statue. Star and Twister were reunited. ===Initiative=== Victoria Star was recruited among the Initiative after the Civil War, revamped along with the Rangers and Armadillo to become the Texas Initiative team. They were soon dragged into action by the attack of the Hydra Terror-Carrier on Prairie Chapel Ranch, "the Western White House". While her teammates fought Hydra in the air or handled civilians on the ground, Shooting Star was to escort and secure the President, facing his refusal to leave the place, stating he had faith in the Initiative. ===Secret Invasion=== Shooting Star later fought in the Skrull invasion with the Rangers joined by the Skrull Kill Krew, confronting "Lobo", the Skrull sleeper agent who had replaced Red Wolf's companion, and killed it with three shots, as Red Wolf and 3-D Man restrained him. Both teams were then assaulted by civilian rioters infiltrated by Skrulls, but the situation was quickly diffused by 3-D Man's ability to detect Skrulls. Along with the Skrulls Kill Crew and their various Initiative allies, the Rangers were teleported through the Negative Zone Portal to Camp Hammond. The Skrulls led by "Dum-Dum Dugan" reacted by releasing lethal gas, affecting Shooting Star. They were all saved by the intervention of Whiz Kid who hurled the gas out using her superspeed (letting herself be affected). Victoria immediately recovered.

victoria von frankenstein.name: Victoria von Frankenstein
victoria von frankenstein.origin: Victoria von Frankenstein lived with the dwarvish creations of her grandfather, Basil, and her father, Ludwig, which she called "the Children", in Castle Frankenstein. Ivan, the former servant of Victoria's great-grandfather, Vincent, located Frankenstein's Monster at Castle Frankenstein, convinced him that his new master, Dr. Walston Kraft, could give him a "real body," and took him to Kraft's castle in Switzerland. Ivan then returned to Castle Frankenstein and imprisoned Victoria in its dungeon to prevent her from interfering. Kraft succeeded in making an army of Frankenclones without the Monster's knowledge. Spider-Man flew to the Alps as Perer Parker to cover a story on Kraft and the International Council on Cloning and Genetic Research. Understandably uncomfortable with cloning due to his past experience with the subject, Peter knew something was up after running into both the Monster and Ivan, the latter of whom threatened him while he was snooping around Kraft's castle. Spider-Man traveled to Castle Frankenstein, where he found and freed Victoria and learned what had been going on. Spider-Man exposed the plot to the Monster, and they both destroyed Kraft's laboratory and castle and foiled his plot. The Monster then left Spider-Man to return to Castle Frankenstein with Victoria. Years later, Victoria had changed her surname to "Fronken-Schteen" and became an attendee of the Guernica Bar. When a group of villains arrived there asking to hide there because one of them was hurt, she managed to cure him, but stated that criminals should not have to come there in the future, because she did not want this place to became a safe haven for villains. She became a friend of Wolverine and when he was hit by a mysterious bullet, she extracted it from Logan's shoulder in order to examine it with other attendees of the bar. She was even present when some of Sabretooth's ninjas attacked the bar in order to kill Robert Templeton, who could find out where Sabretooth was hiding. Along with the attendees and with a little help from Wolverine and Thor, Victoria was able to both defeat the ninjas and aid Wolverine in his war against Sabretooth.

victoria wingate hellstrom.name: Victoria Wingate Hellstrom
victoria wingate hellstrom.origin: Victoria Wingate Hellstrom was born on March, 4 1928. Her ancestors were on the Mayflower. The Hellstrom family were secretly Satanists. Victoria was apparently "sold" to the Chapel of Dresden. They marked her to be the mother of a half-human, half-demon child. On her womb were carved several magical symbols. Victoria considered joining a convent, but was rejected. The demon Marduk Kurios, acting as Satan, arrived in Fire Lake. He quickly seduced and married Victoria. According to another account given by Daimon, Victoria's parents suddenly died after she first met Marduk at Fire Lake. However, it seems this was false. Daimon was born one year later, while Satana was born one year and a half later after her brother. As "Satan" focused more attention on Satana, Victoria and Daimon became closer. Victoria caught Satana performing a ritual sacrifice and her husband revealed to her that he was a demon. She went insane from the experience and was institutionalized. She constantly held an ankh chain as protection from her husband. Victoria wrote a diary to Daimon explaining about his past. However, she did not tell him the full details, either due to her insanity or to not wanting to admit that she had been a willing participant. She died at the mental hospital, on August 21, 1953, and Daimon shortly found her diary at the mansion. Stephen Loss exhumed Victoria's body and confirmed that she had been marked by the Chapel of Dresden, which he had destroyed a few months after Satana's birth.

victory.name: Victory
victory.origin: Victory the Electromagnetic Man, a member of the Squadron Sinister, was present when his team confronted the Avengers on behalf of the Grandmaster. He was pitted against the Avenger Voyager in Pisa, Italy. As soon as the fight started, Voyager's Portal Field reacted with Victory's own Electro-Field, resulting in a devastating explosion that outright disintegrated Victory, while Voyager was phased out of existence. On Earth-616, Voyager was not a member of the Avengers. She was instead a sleeper agent sent by the Grandmaster to infiltrate the group of heroes during a challenge against the Challenger. In order to succeed in her plan, Voyager altered the memories of the Avengers to make them believe she was a long-standing member. These memory alterations mirrored the events surrounding Victory's death.

vidar odinson.name: Vidar Odinson
vidar odinson.species: Asgardian Deity; hybrid son of Asgardian Odin and Storm Giant
vidar odinson.origin: Vidar was the product of Odin's alliance with the Storm Giantess Grid. He was banished from Asgard when Odin married Frigga. Vidar ventured into the city but once to seek redress for the slaying of his wife. As Thor surveyed the devastation the forces of Ragnarok had done across Asgard, he came across Vidar's fields. Vidar had died fighting hordes of trolls, with spears scattered like blades of grass. A funeral pyre was ordered for his body. Like most gods whom died during Ragnarök, he later returned.
