videmus.name: Videmus
videmus.origin: Videmus was a member of the Genetic Council and an Inhuman. Terrigenesis rendered Videmus blind, but gave him the ability to attach to others in order to see through them, also giving him the ability to see their thoughts and retain the memories they shared. Videmus used this power to allow people to share their thoughts with each other. When Pietro Maximoff sought refuge in Attilan following the Decimation, hoping that the Inhumans would allow him to undergo terrigenesis to restore his powers, Videmus befriended him. Videmus aided Pietro in stealing part of the crystals, robbing the Inhumans of their terrigenesis. After turning himself in to King Black Bolt, he revealed that he did so because he believed that the Inhumans seeking refuge on the Moon would dull their warrior instincts and leave them unprepared for the hardships of the future. By robbing them of terrigenesis, he hoped to once again plunge his people into uncertainty, forcing them to fight for the privilege of terrigenesis. As punishment for his crimes, Black Bolt decreed that Videmus was to live out his life in solitary confinement, forbidden from ever again joining his mind to another living soul.

When Pietro Maximoff sought refuge in Attilan following the Decimation, hoping that the Inhumans would allow him to undergo terrigenesis to restore his powers, Videmus befriended him. Videmus aided Pietro in stealing part of the crystals, robbing the Inhumans of their terrigenesis. After turning himself in to King Black Bolt, he revealed that he did so because he believed that the Inhumans seeking refuge on the Moon would dull their warrior instincts and leave them unprepared for the hardships of the future. By robbing them of terrigenesis, he hoped to once again plunge his people into uncertainty, forcing them to fight for the privilege of terrigenesis. As punishment for his crimes, Black Bolt decreed that Videmus was to live out his life in solitary confinement, forbidden from ever again joining his mind to another living soul.

videoman.name: Videoman
videoman.first_appearance: Spider-Man Family Featuring Amazing Friends Vol 1 1
videoman.origin: Videoman's full origins are unrevealed. Powered by a computer processor unit, the electronic being emerged from a classic "Videoman" arcade video game and rampaged throughout Madison Square Garden. Spider-Man (Peter Parker) and Iceman quickly disposed of the menace when Iceman froze the two-dimensional creature and Spider-Man shattered its body. Apparently not realizing Videoman's power source, the two left the processor unit behind. Some time later, Videoman reconstituted its form (this time as a two-sided being) and attacked Spider-Man. The surprise attack left Spider-Man weakened and Videoman almost defeated the hero. Iceman and Firestar, who were nearby, interrupted its assault. Firestar's microwave blasts scrambled Videoman's form, which gave Iceman the opportunity to freeze his internal processor unit. Videoman's form blinked out of existence, leaving only the processor unit. Spider-Man took the unit into his possession for safekeeping, promising to keep it in his freezer.

vienna.name: Vienna
vienna.origin: Vienna posed as a stewardess on a plane where Shang-Chi, the Master of Kung-Fu, was traveling on. Shang-Chi was threatened by a guy named Kiley and Vienna helped him out. She became attracted to him and wanted to be partners-in-crime, but Shang refused to put her life in danger. Some time afterward, she posed as a nun to help both Power-Man and Iron Fist take down a villain named Stoneface. Next, she was seen as Angela Tortelli, where she acted as the wife of mobster Joey Tortelli. It was here she met Colleen Wing and Misty Knight and manipulated them into bringing down a rival mobster. They later worked together against a villain named Impasse for which she got paid $20,000. ===Civil War & Heroes for Hire=== After the heroes known as the New Warriors caused trouble for both the superhero and supervillain community by failing to stop Nitro triggering an explosion in Stamford, Connecticut, Vienna decided to accept the forthcoming new law and register. She secretly joined up with the Heroes for Hire, and was working alongside Misty and Colleen once again. Vienna offered her services to the supervillain community by creating new fake identities for them so they could leave the country or go into hiding. However, when all the villains were rounded up in one building, Vienna informed the Heroes For Hire and they arrested all of the criminals, with Vienna's help and for which she received a cash reward.

vigil of vontsalvant.name: Vigil of Vontsalvant
vigil of vontsalvant.origin: The Vigil of Vontsalvant was an unnamed man and the last of his people on the planet Vontsalvant in the Negative Zone. His planet was powered by the Crystals of Vontsalvant, though the supply began to dwindle and conflict broke out which ultimately left the Vigil as the sole survivor. He deemed himself unworthy of the crystals and stock piled them and left one out as a lure, to attract those who he deemed worthy by the strength of their character. Annihilus attempted three time to obtain a crystal but the Vigil defeated him three times. He was found by The Thing and they fought with Ben overpowering the Vigil and the Vigil was trapped under rubble. he demanded the Thing kill him, but Ben refused and then saved the Vigil from a roof collapse. The Vigil deemed the Thing worthy and gave him the crystal. After Ben left, the Vigil set up another crystal and waited for the next person he would deem worthy.

viktor mutant.name: Viktor (Mutant)
viktor mutant.origin: Nothing is known of Viktor's past. He was a nightclub owner in Prague who was secretly a brutal human trafficker, preying on other mutants who sought jobs at his club and selling them to the highest bidder. One of his "clients" was the corrupt DermaFree Corporation, which the mutant spy Mystique had been sent to bring down. To do that, she infiltrated Viktor's gang as a customer, stating an intent to buy one of his captive mutants. Once Viktor led her to the holding cell where the mutants were being kept, Mystique attacked, stabbing Viktor in the back with a knife. Viktor struck back, entangling Mystique and Luc, one of his captives who had come to her defense, with his tentacles, before being felled by a burst of light from another one of the enslaved mutants, Tanya. An enraged Mystique then dragged Viktor off and stabbed him to death.

viktor komolov.name: Viktor Komolov
viktor komolov.origin: A high-ranking member of the Solntsevskaya Bratva, Viktor Komolov learned the ways of black magic, and shared his knowledge with his men. With these powers, Komolov set out to bring back Omega Red back from the dead. To this end, he made a deal with the Hand, trading them victims of human-trafficking in exchange for the coffin that contained the remains of Omega Red, Komolov and his men subsequently carried out a ritual that resulted in Omega Red's rebirth. However, this was temporary, which required Omega Red to regularly feed on people's life energy. And even then, that only delayed his body's inevitable decay. Komolov's right hand Anatoly Rasputin was the estranged uncle of powerful sorceress and X-Men member Magik. Under the pretense he was tipping them off about Omega Red's return, Anatoly lured the X-Men to Russia, and set up an ambush during which Komolov's men kidnapped Magik, with the intention to force her to empower Omega Red and prevent his decay. Even though Komolov had already forced Magik to strengthen Omega Red when the X-Men attacked his base, they managed to rescue their teammate and defeat Komolov, who was subsequently taken into custody by S.I.C.K.L.E..

viktor uvarov.origin: ===Leviathan=== Viktor Uvarov (Russian: Виктор Уваров), alias Orion, was the leader Leviathan, an organization based in Russia that was created for the purpose of world domination. His right-hand man was Magadan. Orion made contact with Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine after her parents, who were seemingly double agents for both Russia and the USA, were killed by a bomb in Rome. Two days later, she was weeping in a church before their coffins. She was then approached by Uvarov who addressed her as "comrade." Contessa demanded to know why he did not contact her sooner, as the Consulate had been asking questions about her paperwork. Uvarov promised her that nothing was wrong and promised that she could continue her parents' work as undercover agents. Moreover, he promised a higher position for her. The day after, at her parents' funeral, the Contessa was approached by Dum Dum Dugan, who commented on how her parents worked against communism. He then offered to recruit her into S.H.I.E.L.D. ===Great Wheel=== Orion and Magadan were contacted by the Brotherhood of the Shield and were brought to the Immortal City to meet with Leonardo da Vinci in Pieta. Along with other intelligence agents from around the globe—Jake Fury, John Garrett, Shoji Soma, Cornelius van Lunt, Nick Fury, Baron Strucker, Dum Dum Dugan, Thomas Davidson, and the Kraken—they formed the Great Wheel. Each member was assigned a codename from the zodiac, Orion being Cancer. Leonardo da Vinci was the leader as Aries, sent the rest of the Wheel on three key retrieval missions, and promised them resources that would be of great value to their own separate agendas. Orion and Magadan betrayed the Wheel and stole the chambers and the Brood power source retrieved in the missions. When those were used in conjunction, they could greatly enhance any human, and the two Leviathan leaders planned to transform Leviathan into a superhuman army. However, they were stopped by Baron Strucker and Shoji Soma. Strucker stabbed Orion with the Spear of Imhotep. Magadan placed Orion in a chamber where he would remain in stasis for decades alongside most of Leviathan while Magadan searched for the stolen Brood power source, which Soma had hidden in a box. ===Secret Warriors=== When Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine stole the box from Hydra by posing as Madame Hydra, she and Magadan awakened Orion and the rest of Leviathan. Contessa also killed the Viper. When Hydra arrived at the Leviathan base Long Winter in Siberia, they found it deserted, except for a few squads left behind and the corpse of Viper. One Hydra agent brought Baron von Strucker a holographic recorder, which projected an image of Orion, whom Strucker recognized as Viktor Uvarov. When the device recognized his voiceprint, Orion's message played that despite the unfortunate mishaps between their two organizations during his sleep, they should meet at the Crown in three days. Orion, Magadan, and Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine arrived to meet with the leaders of Hydra. The Contessa was shocked to see Viper alive, with tentacles on her head. As the meetings began, Orion requested an offer of subservience from Hydra. Strucker refused and ordered Gorgon to kill him. However, Orion survived a stab to the shoulder as Magadan whacked him away with his hammer. It was then that a Leviathan squadron attacked. The leaders of both sides escaped the destruction of the Crown. As a result, all-out war was declared between Hydra and Leviathan. Both terrorist organizations went to extreme lengths in their methods, such as taking out entire bases without regard for civilians. Eventually, the Leviathan thought to make a ceasefire, only for one of their leaders, Magadan, to be assassinated. In retaliation, Leviathan took out a Hydra recruitment center in Seattle. At the newest Leviathan base, Perestroika, Orion, and Contessa Valentina Allegra de la Fontaine plotted to assault Gorgon and Madame Hydra. Then suddenly, all their Leviathan soldiers began to self-destruct. fields.notes: In , Orion is said to have been in stasis for 14 years. However, in , it is revealed that he was put in stasis in 1961, which puts an immense strain of the timeline, even when taking the sliding timescale into account. vili borson.name: Vili Borson
vili borson.origin: According to Odin's disembodied giant eye, the last cycle of Ragnarök ended roughly 2,000 years ago. Ve and Vili Borson were among the nine gods who survived the twilight of the gods. Together with Odin's sons, Vidar and Vali, they discovered the discarded spear of Odin, Gungnir. The four gods grasped the spear together and were transformed into a composite entity -- Odin, the new All-Father of the next age of Gods. thumb|left Vili, together with his brothers Odin and Ve, led the early Asgardians in a war against the Frost Giants of Niffleheim and built Asgard, the capital city of the Asgardian realm. The brothers learned that Surtur was planning destroy the Nine Worlds by igniting his giant flame sword with the Eternal Flame of Destruction and so they set out to stop him. In order to stop this the brothers magically merged into a giant the size of Surtur and in this form succeeded in shattering Surtur's sword. Returning to their individual forms the brothers carried off the brazier holding the Eternal Flame of Destruction. Surtur and his hordes pursued them to the interdimensional nexus between Asgard and Muspelheim. In the course of events, Odin rode through the nexus carrying the brazier, but Vili and Ve were forced to stay behind in Muspelheim, in order to stop Surtur's forces. When they died, their power was transferred to Odin and the Odin-Force was created.

viliven.name: Viliven
viliven.origin: Viliven was the Seamstress-Queen of the Tapestry Islands, in the Winding Way, part of the Splinter Realms (also known as of the Archipelago of Anguish and Redemption). As such, she was one of the Lords of the Splinter Realms. She ruled over the Weaver Witches who resided on the Tapestry Islands. She was a long-time foe of Molgotha, another Lord of the Splinter Realms. Viliven came to the convocation called by Magik to help defeat the Archenemy. She agreed with Molgotha's proposal that anyone who broke their new pact would face death, considering no trust could be set otherwise.

villac umu.name: Villac Umu
villac umu.origin: Villac Umu was the Jaguar Priest of a tribe of Incas lost in a time warp in the Bermuda Triangle. He served Captain Victor Cochran, whom the tribe worshipped as the sun god Viracocha, but shortly after the arrival of Skull the Slayer and his time-lost team, he mounted a coup which apparently resulted in Cochran's death. After retaking the leadership of his tribe, he led a horde of warriors flying pterodactyls back through the time warp to attack Cape Canaveral. Villac Umu apparently fell to his death when he was knocked from his pterodactyl's back by the Thing after taking Ann Reynolds hostage.

vin.name: Vin
vin.origin: Vin was a synthezoid created by the Vision in his process to humanize himself through the creation of a family. The brainwaves of Vin and his co-creation and twin sister Vivian ("Viv" for short) came from the combination of the brain patterns of the Vision and Virginia, Viv and Vin's mother and Vision's wife. The Visions moved to Arlington, Virginia, in order to facilitate Vision becoming the Avengers' White House liaison. The family became instant celebrities, with their neighbors constantly seeking pictures, which they shared online. This caught the attention of Eric Williams, who became upset that Vision would create a family that appeared to be happy, when the Williams family wasn't, as well as the fact that the Vision's brainwaves were taken from his brother, Simon, in the first place. Both Vin and Viv attended to school at the Alexander Hamilton High School in Fairfax, but they were assigned different schedules to help them assimilate their classmates. One night, while their father was away with the Avengers, the Grim Reaper broke into the Visions' home, running Viv through with his scythe. Vin rushed to her aid, but he too was struck down. Virginia then flew into a rage and beat Eric to death in front of her wounded children with a cookie sheet on their kitchen floor. In order to maintain the harmony of their household, Virginia asked her children not to tell their father about the events that had just transpired. Vin was left extremely distraught by the incident, displaying an erratic and apathetic behavior. This caused him to attack fellow student Chris Kinzky, Viv's lab partner, when he asked about Viv's absence from school. As a consequence of this scuffle, Vin was suspended from class. Vin's emotional condition improved once Viv recovered from her injuries. During a conversation with Viv, Chris Kinzky revealed he forgave Vin for his behavior. The Visions were soon visited by Victor Mancha, the "brother" of the Vision. One night, when Vin was playing with his dog Sparky, he accidentally came across Victor reporting to the Avengers. Victor's visit was a front for a secret investigation on the Vision, due to Agatha Harkness having alerted the Avengers of a potential tragedy that could be caused by the android. Victor used his electromagnetic powers to contain Vin and prevent him from outing his operations, but a miscalculation caused him to damage Vin's nerve systems beyond repair, killing the boy as he cried for his father while accidentally destroying the neighboring 620 Hickory Branch Lane.

fields.history: Vin was a synthezoid created by the Vision in his process to humanize himself through the creation of a family. The brainwaves of Vin and his co-creation and twin sister Vivian ("Viv" for short) came from the combination of the brain patterns of the Vision and Virginia, Viv and Vin's mother and Vision's wife. The Visions moved to Arlington, Virginia, in order to facilitate Vision becoming the Avengers' White House liaison. The family became instant celebrities, with their neighbors constantly seeking pictures, which they shared online. This caught the attention of Eric Williams, who became upset that Vision would create a family that appeared to be happy, when the Williams family wasn't, as well as the fact that the Vision's brainwaves were taken from his brother, Simon, in the first place. Both Vin and Viv attended to school at the Alexander Hamilton High School in Fairfax, but they were assigned different schedules to help them assimilate their classmates. One night, while their father was away with the Avengers, the Grim Reaper broke into the Visions' home, running Viv through with his scythe. Vin rushed to her aid, but he too was struck down. Virginia then flew into a rage and beat Eric to death in front of her wounded children with a cookie sheet on their kitchen floor. In order to maintain the harmony of their household, Virginia asked her children not to tell their father about the events that had just transpired. Vin was left extremely distraught by the incident, displaying an erratic and apathetic behavior. This caused him to attack fellow student Chris Kinzky, Viv's lab partner, when he asked about Viv's absence from school. As a consequence of this scuffle, Vin was suspended from class. Vin's emotional condition improved once Viv recovered from her injuries. During a conversation with Viv, Chris Kinzky revealed he forgave Vin for his behavior. The Visions were soon visited by Victor Mancha, the "brother" of the Vision. One night, when Vin was playing with his dog Sparky, he accidentally came across Victor reporting to the Avengers. Victor's visit was a front for a secret investigation on the Vision, due to Agatha Harkness having alerted the Avengers of a potential tragedy that could be caused by the android. Victor used his electromagnetic powers to contain Vin and prevent him from outing his operations, but a miscalculation caused him to damage Vin's nerve systems beyond repair, killing the boy as he cried for his father while accidentally destroying the neighboring 620 Hickory Branch Lane.

vin corsico.name: Vin Corsico
vin corsico.origin: Vin Corsico was a superpowered sex offender who volunteered for Project Echelon, a U.S. government super-soldier program. While at a military research facility, Corsico was killed by the Red She-Hulk, who snapped his neck. Unaware that she had fatally injured him, the Red She-Hulk ordered one of the scientists to resuscitate him, only to be informed that Corsico had no vital signs. She subsequently ordered everyone in the facility to evacuate. After the building collapsed, Machine Man arrived at the site and determined that the staff had successfully evacuated. He discovered Corsico's body among the wreckage and attempted to revive him with electronic jolts, but ultimately pronounced him dead.

vin tak.name: Vin-Tak
vin tak.origin: Vin-Tak was a Kree who came to Earth after he received a signal indicating that a Diviner had been activated. He came armed with a truncheon that could take away the memories of anyone who was jabbed with it, and used nitrogen to dye his naturally blue skin the color of a Caucasian human's. The Asgardians sent the warrior Lady Sif to Earth after him, as they did not trust the Kree. She tracked Vin-Tak to Portugal, but he managed to erase her memories during a fight. Vin-Tak escaped to a nearby hospital, where he used their stores of liquid nitrogen to dye his skin again. However, Vin-Tak's actions also attracted the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Two S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Bobbi Morse and Skye found Vin-Tak at the hospital and challenged him. While they were fighting, a small earthquake broke out, giving Vin-Tak an opportunity to escape. He made his way to the city of Chaves, where he found a crate containing Terrigen Crystals, but S.H.I.E.L.D. managed to track him there and corner him while he was leaving. Vin-Tak put up a fight, but one of the agents fired an electrified net towards him that knocked him out. S.H.I.E.L.D. took him into custody and started questioning him aboard their plane. Vin-Tak tried to explain his purpose on Earth, and said he only wanted to help. When they got back to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s headquarters, Vin-Tak used his truncheon to return Sif's memories. He explained why he was on Earth, as well as his people's history on Earth and Terrigenesis. While he was explaining this to them, one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s scientists, Jemma Simmons, discovered the crate Vin-Tak found was empty. Realizing his worst fears has come true, he urged S.H.I.E.L.D. to help him find the remaining Terrigen crystals, and anyone who had been transformed by them. He soon discovered Skye was one of the people who had recently undergone Terrigenesis, and he and Sif tried to convince S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director Phil Coulson to hand her over to them. Coulson refused, and Skye escaped to the facility's jail cell, but Vin-Tak and Sif chased after them. Agent Morse, however, managed to distract Vin-Tak away from Skye. During their fight, Agent Morse got her hands on Vin-Tak's truncheon and erased his own memories with it. The two aliens eventually agreed to let Skye stay on Earth. Sif took Vin-Tak back with her to Asgard, promising to give him safe passage back to Hala.

vinatos.name: Vinatos
vinatos.species: Inhuman subjected to the Terrigen Mists
vinatos.origin: Vinatos was the Medical Regent in charge of the health and well-being of the the Inhuman Royal Family. After the fall of their city Attilan, Queen Medusa tasked Vinatos with the examination of the new Inhuman Inferno, his sister, Gabriela, and the cocoon of their deceased mother. Dante became very ill-tempered and told Vinatos to stay away from his family. Vinatos then got verbal after Dante insulted Queen Medusa, but Medusa told Vinatos to let it go, saying that the boy was unfamiliar with their customs. He would later assist Kamala Khan after a violent encounter and would introduce Kamala to her nature as an Inhuman. Vinatos would perish confronting by The Unspoken who had taken over the city of Attilan. As he distracted the tyrant, the latter killed him with a powerful energy blast, as The Unspoken recalled Vinatos had not supported him when the former was driven from the throne. Inferno, Naja and Flint then succeeded in defeating The Unspoken. During his funeral, Queen Medusa (having been affected by the inversion spell while in Genosha ) threw his coffin into the sea.

vince garone.name: Vince Garone
vince garone.origin: Vince Garone was crime boss who was a bootlegger during Prohibition. In the 1940s, he decided to establish a legitimate business and started up a trucking company. While his business was legal, his methods of dealing with the competition were far from. He had his gang pressure competing truckers to join his company. Those who refused were driven off the road to their deaths. When Garone's men threatened trucker Hank Steel, Steel refused to give into Garone. When Steel became Garone's next target, it attracted the attention of the other-dimensional Vision who smashed Garone's gang. As Garone attempted to flee the scene, the Vision used his illusion casting powers to frighten Garone off the road. His car drove off a cliff to a fatal crash, a fitting end for someone who sent so many innocent men to the same fate.

vince kane.name: Vince Kane
vince kane.origin: Vince Kane was a mob boss in the 1920's who ran the Yellow Spider Gang which operated a racket through Kane Export Company. He began to worry own his subordinate Al Rocco was making moves against him. He found a doll that looked exactly like Rocco and brought it. After stabbing it with a pin noticing Rocco flinch he determined it to be a voodoo doll. He devised a idea to throw it out of the window of their 13th story office. However, Rocco secretly changed the doll to like Vince, which he did not realize until too late and watched in horror as the doll fell to the sidewalk below.

That operation was made to keep the Skrulls' presence on Earth a secret, but 3-D Man discovered them, stopped the car and Vince returned to jail.

vincent astor.name: Vincent Astor
vincent astor.origin: Vincent Astor was an old friend of President Roosevelt, and also ran a secret intelligence group known as the Room. He was responsible for financing Dr. Phineas Horton's Human Torch project in order to compete against Nazi Germany's Project Nietzche. When the Human Torch received public backlash, Astor regrettably told Dr. Horton that the President had given orders that the Human Torch must be encase in cement.

vincent beckers.origin: Vincent Beckers was a scientist who worked for Hydra during World War II under the Red Skull. Beckers' family maintained their connections to Hydra long after the organization went into hiding, as his grandson Julien was secretly an agent of Hydra in 2014. S.H.I.E.L.D. uncovered Julien's connections to Hydra through his grandfather while they were investigating him.

vincent bloch.name: Vincent Bloch
vincent bloch.origin: Little is known about Father Bloch, except that he was a mutant who became a priest in the Church of the Blessed Sacrament in New York City, and that he was targeted by Project: Wideawake's Hound program. They sent Sabretooth to retrieve him, but Creed had no intention of bringing him back alive. Sabretooth ambushed Bloch as he was preparing for a wedding ceremony, but before he could attack, he was himself set upon by his old enemy, Omega Red. In the ensuing melee, Bloch ran for his life.

vincent calabresse.name: Vincent Calabresse
vincent calabresse.origin: Vincent Calabresse was one of six New York crime bosses whom agent Fred Pierson hired Deadpool to assassinate. Although Deadpool quickly killed the other five, his attempt on Calabresse failed, and Calabresse was hospitalized. At the hospital, Deadpool used an image inducer to manipulate Calabresse’s men and orchestrate another attempt on his life. Later, during a confrontation involving Pierson and others, Calabresse forced his bodyguard Busta Bloodvessel to crash their car, but the vehicle exploded, killing Calabresse and leaving Bloodvessel unconscious.

vincent cetewayo.name: Vincent Cetewayo
vincent cetewayo.origin: Vincent Cetewayo was a political activist born in Imaya. During the government of President Letumba, Cetewayo was arrested and imprisoned by Eda Arul, a demented prison guard who later claimed to be disgusted at having to carry food and clean up filth (possibly caused by torture) for someone like Cetewayo. Cetewayo remembered Arul as a brutal sadist. With the help of the mysterious Advisor, Arul staged a coup and seized power, turning Imaya into a dictatorship. The Advisor and his true masters had convoluted plans of conflict and oppression that Cetewayo was an inconvenience to, but the Advisor decided that if Cetewayo were killed like this, he would become a martyr and further negatively affect their plans. Thus, Cetewayo escaped from Imaya during the transition, and became a tireless advocate for human rights, fighting for the oppressed and exposing the abuses of the oppressors. Cetewayo gained international renown as a lecturer and humanitarian. Although operating internationally, Cetewayo maintained his home and base in Los Angeles and obtained American citizenship. Throughout his career, Cetewayo was famous for negotiating the South Asian Peace Treaty, for paying for airlifts of food to Ethiopia out of his own pocket, for single-handedly convincing a terrorist not to detonate a tactical nuke in Belfast, and for telling cigar-smoking Nick Fury, Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., that they were in a no-smoking area in the United Nations Security Council Chamber. Cetewayo also gave a lecture at the University of California, Berkeley, in 1981 this date should be considered topical), which was attended by student Michael Collins (years later the superhero Deathlok); Collins was impressed by Cetewayo's words about responsibility, and years later Cetewayo would remember Collins as the person in the audience who had had the most questions for him, and all of them good ones. During the fifteen years since Cetewayo's escape, Arul wished he had killed him in prison when he had had the chance, and Cetewayo also remembered Arul, especially in his nightmares. Throughout his career, Cetewayo encountered Arul's mysterious Advisor in South Africa, (in Johannesburg), and apparently also in Cambodia, Iraq, Texas (in Waco), Zaire, and elsewhere, where Cetewayo found him creepy; Cetewayo would later claim that it was the same person, with different faces. Cetewayo wrote and published a book of memoirs, "A Destiny To Create," in which he outlined his hopes for global peace while also bearing witness to Arul's abuses in Imaya (which Arul perceived as seditious propaganda). The book also detailed the geography of Imaya. Simultaneously, Cetewayo founded Worldwatch (Worldwatch Incorporated), a human rights organization dedicated to coordinating the efforts of relief agencies to maximize their effectiveness and to exert political and diplomatic pressure on situations requiring so, exposing injustices and abuses of power across the globe, while maintaining as much political neutrality as possible - basically what Cetewayo had been doing individually his entire life, but on a grander scale. Cetewayo was quite far along in creating Worldwatch, but out of an abundance of caution he didn't share too many details with outsiders. Cetewayo assembled an executive board of trusted associates and co-founders Rebecca Bergier and Dr. Ranald Jeffries, and established Worldwatch HQ in Los Angeles; but he did not intend to lead Worldwatch personally, instead looking for another director: James Rhodes, who had been until recently CEO of Stark Enterprises, and who they were able to contact through Rae LaCoste, who was both Dr. Jeffries's friend and Rhodes' girlfriend. LaCoste convinced Rhodes by offering him a simple dinner with friends that included Cetewayo, without telling him that they were going to offer him a job, and Rhodes felt honored to be able to meet someone like Cetewayo in person. Cetewayo was cordial, friendly, and cheerful, saying that they too were honored to have met Rhodes. After Cetewayo and his associates explained the vision of Wordwatch to Rhodes, Cetewayo offered Rhodes the position of executive director, because Rhodes had proven his administrative and moral abilities to Stark. Rhodes declined the offer, and when Bergier tried to convince him, Cetewayo asked her not to insist, since Rhodes had made his decision. Cetewayo gave Rhodes a copy of his book, and soon Rhodes understood he had not made the right decision. Meanwhile, Arul, enraged by how the book described him, vowed to kill Cetewayo. After giving a public speech to the people of Imaya extolling the virtues of the nation Cetewayo criticized, and privately regretting having allowed Cetewayo to go so far, Arul commissioned the Advisor to have Cetewayo kidnapped to be tried as a subversive. fields.personality: Vincent Cetewayo was a political activist who dedicated his life to coordinating the efforts of relief agencies to maximize their effectiveness, and to exerting political and diplomatic pressure on situations he felt required someone to do so, in addition to exposing injustices and abuses of power around the world, maintaining the greatest possible political neutrality to protect the innocent from those who have no qualms about harming others to maintain their power. Cetewayo firmly believed in the sanctity of liberty, the sacredness of life, and the rights of the individual. His trusted associate Rebecca Bergier believed that Cetewayo had worked his entire life to prevent wars, although there were times when he approved of armed conflict to defend innocents. Before beginning that career, Cetewayo had been a prisoner in Imaya during the Letumba government, and his jailer, the brutal and erratic Eda Arul, remembered (or thought he remembered) that Cetewayo had mocked him when he had brought him food and cleaned his "filth." Cetewayo was a brave man who challenged more powerful people publicly and openly (for example, when he was recaptured by Arul, who had become dictator, Cetewayo was unwilling to address Arul as Your Excellency and antagonized Arul instead, knowing that the sadistic Arul would beat him up), but he took care to be polite to his friends and potential friends, and he remembered many people he had encountered in his life: When Cetewayo gave a lecture at the University of California, Berkeley, student Michael Collins asked him many very good questions, and Cetewayo remembered him years later. Cetewayo encountered the supernatural creature called the Advisor, who used different faces, in various places, and he also He remembered him even when the Advisor had changed his identity. Cetewayo formed a relationship with his trusted associates Rebecca Bergier and Dr. Ranald Jeffries, who would go on to become Worldwatch's executive board, and he was also aware of several other people he had not yet met but had potential as allies, such as James Rhodes. When they finally met, Rhodes found Cetewayo to be surprisingly cheerful for someone who had seen so much evil; Cetewayo suggested that it was because he still had hope that the world could change for the better. Cetewayo was a persuasive man, and also a gentleman: When he made an offer and his interlocutor rejected it, Cetewayo accepted that the other person had made a decision and did not insist, as when Rhodes did not want to lead Worldwatch (Cetewayo even asked Bergier not to insist) and when Deathlok (Collins) refused to join an armed resistance. However, in both cases, he was able to reach a brief compromise: With Rhodes, he convinced him to accept and read the book Cetewayo had written, hoping he would change his mind, and with Deathlok, to get him to smuggle wounded combatants out of the conflict zone. As Dr. Jeffries would later state, Cetewayo had learned to be secretive and not reveal his cards before time. At the end of his life, Cetewayo decided he was offered the opportunity to join an armed resistance against dictator Eda Arul, who had been in power for fifteen years in his home country of Imaya. To the surprise of everyone, Cetewayo wanted to join the conflict, even if it required him to fight personally. However, before he could actively contribute, Cetewayo was intercepted by the Advisor, who revealed at least part of his plans and nature to him, shocking him with his inhuman cruelty. Although Cetewayo had stoically endured torture at the hands of Arul just days before, knowing that Arul planned to execute him, Cetewayo begged the Advisor for his life so he could return to the people Cetewayo loved and continue his work. The Advisor killed Cetewayo in a way that minimized his work, but acknowledged that Cetewayo was a fascinating person.

fields.trivia: When Cetewayo first met James Rhodes in person, Cetewayo said he wanted to found Worldwatch, suggesting that he had not done it yet. However, by the time Cetewayo was kidnapped just a couple days later, Worldwatch was already founded and the staff was already hired, as Rhodes would find out after returning to Los Angeles from Imaya. Jeffries told Rhodes that Cetewayo was cautious about revealing details. Watching the Imayan Civil War on TV, Cetewayo's associate Rebecca Bergier said that Cetewayo had worked all his life to end that kind of conflict, but he was being blamed for it. However, at that point, Cetewayo had actively joined the armed resistance against Arul, which suggests that maybe Bergier did not know Cetewayo as well as she believed.

vincent destine.name: Vincent Destine
vincent destine.origin: ===Origins=== Compared to his siblings, Vincent was adept at using his magical gifts at a very young age. As a child, Vincent was already able to travel in time, tap into other dimensions, and summon elementals. When he was still a child, Vincent summoned an earth elemental (who was actually the Thing) to act as his bodyguard as he traveled to ancient Rome and to the jurassic era. He reappeared at Ravenscroft Manor five years after his disappearance, wearing his same clothes but with fresh wounds. To figure out what was happening, Adam consulted with Newton and Albert Einstein. As a child, Vincent time-traveled to before 1949 to give Chen Yu a mystic box that when opened would release a Hellspawn. Chen Yu was able to use this box in a battle against Wolverine who almost died if not for the timely intervention of Adam Destine. In 1969, an adolescent Vincent attended Woodstock with his brothers Will, Newton, Sebastian, Maurice, and Dominic using Adam's VW van. During the festival, Vincent was summoned a fire elemental (who was actually the Human Torch). While he was still a man, Vincent traveled to ancient Egypt to convince Neb Maat to gather and embalm the Heliopolitan hybrids. ===Death=== As Vincent grew older, he became disenchanted with the world. Believing that the Destine family has a responsibility to make the world better. Tapping on the power of the other dimensional realm, he was able to hurt even the invulnerable Adam Destine, however, in the end, Adam believing that the body of Vincent has been possessed by the creatures from that dimension, was forced to end Vincent's life. Vincent's death left Ravenscroft Manor in ruins and caused a rift within the Destine family, especially to Dominic who understood Vincent. Adam also exile himself in deep space. ===Rebirth=== After Adam Destine saved his wife and the Clan Destine from Alpha by absorbing the mystical energies of the Destine's stolen by Alpha and his clones, and returning it Elalyth and their children, some of the mystical energies remained and these energies strangely went to the grave of Vincent Destine. Apparently, the mystical energies resurrected Vincent but not enough. Vincent soul needed a host in order to manifest on Earth, so he beamed his energies to body of a Plastoid which was apparently being stored by the Fantastic Four. Using the Plastoid, Vincent apparently went about looking for a human host to possess but all the human he possesses dies apparently because it could not handle the energies possessed by Vincent's soul. vincent dio.name: Vincent Dio
vincent dio.origin: Vincent "Vince" Dio is the brother of Jack "Jackie" Dio. They both worked under Silvermane just prior to the surge in super-humans and costumed beings in the New York crime scene, both as superheroes and super-villains. Vince saw that super-human enhancement was the way of the future, however, after their father's death at the hands of a costumed criminal, Jack was vehemently against allowing super criminals into organized crime. Charged with taking care of his brother Vince, Jackie and Vince came to blows over bringing in super criminals into their criminal activities. Vince eventually overstepped his boundaries, and Jackie beat him senseless and told him to leave town. Vince then worked with the police in trapping his brother, and although Jackie held his ground against the police, the intervention by Spider-Man led to Jackie's arrest and landed him in the Cage for the next 10 years. In that time, Vince received strength enhancements from the Consultant, an underworld provider of enhanced abilities and advanced weapons. He became Mister Pain, a high-ranking enforcer in the Owl's mob. In modern times, once Jackie Dio had been released from prison, in trying to get back into the underworld, Jackie was worked over by Vince. After the experience, Jackie targeted the Owl's operation and was manipulated by the Consultant into becoming the super-criminal known as Underworld. Vince's private vendetta against Jackie, and his desire to stop him from ruining Jackie's attempt to work for the Owl, led to a final confrontation between the two in which Jackie, thanks to his enhancements by the Consultant, was able to beat Mr. Pain, and killed him for all the trouble he'd given Jackie since getting out of prison.

vincent esquida.name: Vincent Esquida
vincent esquida.origin: Doctor Vincent Esquida was the scientist behind Project: W for Aladdin, a project designed to engineer and train Aladdin's own Ultra agent, the Wrath. Although Thomas Hunter was technically successful as the Wrath, Esquida wanted to move on to grander experiments with Ultra agents. When Colonel Carpenter and Aladdin's brass refused, Esquida was willing to have Hunter killed in order to clear up funding for his new projects. He arranged for the Radicals (a group of AWOL former agents who hated Hunter) to attack Wrath for him. When his plans failed, Doctor Esquida was terminated by Colonel Carpenter using a bomb.

vincent farnsworth.name: Vincent Farnsworth
vincent farnsworth.origin: Vincent Farnsworth was the company manager of , specialized in safes and vaults. At a club he frequented, he had an argument with Henry Marsh, who revealed to him his theory of powered people, the mutants, with abilities such as mind-reading, defying gravity or moving through walls. According to Marsh, most of them were unaware of their own powers, and the others kept them secret from normal men who would fear and distrust them. Farnsworth laughed at that theory, and departed to his office. There, a new vault was then sent into his office. Still thinking about Marsh's mutants, Farnsworth entered the safe in order to check his new product, and was accidentally trapped inside by Joe, the janitor. Suffocating in the safe, Farnsworth revealed himself a mutant by moving through the safe, saving himself. Understanding that he was one of the mutants, and why Marsh had stated they remained in secrecy, Farnsworth decided to remain hidden as well. One week later, Marsh and Farnsworth met again at the club, and while Marsh asked him again about his theory, Farnsworth pretended to still think the idea fake, while asking himself if Marsh was not a mutant himself.

vincent fasinera.name: Vincent Fasinera
vincent fasinera.origin: Vincent Fasinera met a nun and his soon to be wife Scarlet at a church, where Vincent came searching for a priest to forgive him for his actions. As the priest was away from the church at the time, Vincent instead clung to Scarlets robes and begged her for forgiveness instead. 6 months later, he and Scarlet are married and begin living together. Vincent, however, turns and begins mistreating Scarlet once they have fully settled together. Scarlet and Vince's son Joseph Fasinera is eventually born, yet Vincent shows little care for the boy. Ultimately, Vincent decides one night to rob a bank, shooting a guard in the process and is then shot dead in a police shootout on the churches doorsteps.

vincent frankenstein.name: Vincent Frankenstein
vincent frankenstein.origin: Frankenstein's Monster headed back to Geneva, where he encountered Vincent Frankenstein, Ernst Frankenstein's great-grandson. Vincent was served by Ivan, a monstrous hunchback. Vincent set out to find the Monster after hearing of his sittings and convinced the Monster to return with him to Castle Frankenstein. Vincent convinced the Monster he could transfer his brain into a more normal-looking body, and he convinced Ivan that he would then put his brain into the Monster's body. Vincent was not certain whether this was possible, but thought it a great opportunity for the Monster if it did succeed, and if it failed, it would still be great for science. Vincent, however, miscalculated the dose of anesthetic it would take for the Monster to be sedated, which resulted in the Monster being disoriented instead and Ivan being forced to subdue him. Fearing that Ivan would kill the Monster, Vincent shot and killed him.

vincent gardner.name: Vincent Gardner
vincent gardner.origin: A female mutant, Cooter has the ability to amplify the greed of others, making them susceptible to suggestion. However, it doesn’t work on those who are too honest or have too little imagination. She persuades a pub that the pebbles she carries are actually gold nuggets. This brings her into conflict with Captain Britain and Meggan, who are in the pub. She sets her cousin Bash on them. When they are later arrested, and Captain Britain and Meggan have left, she convinces the bar patrons and police that the rubble of the pub is made of gold, and they make their escape in a stolen car, suggesting they go to America.

vincent gross.origin: Dr. Vincent Gross was a genetic researcher working for the American government. Considered a genius, albeit with rogue tendencies, his funding was cut when it was revealed he was experimenting on infant humans. Unable to find employment after this, Gross was forced underground, using common street thugs to steal the funding for his research.

vincent kruger.name: Vincent Kruger
vincent kruger.origin: Elderly, wheelchair-bound Vincent Kruger is left with a dilemma when his butler, Jeeves, becomes the latest in a long line of servants to storm off the property, due to fears of a locked room Kruger keeps in his home. While worrying about having to find another servant, Kruger is startled to when to find a mysterious man in his home. The man, balding with a heavily scarred face, introduces himself as Hauntly, and announces himself as Kruger's new servant. Confused, Kruger agrees, and the both of them turn in for the night. In the following days and weeks, Kruger grows more and more unhappy with Hauntly's presence, and his knowledge of Kruger's secret room. One morning, Hauntly informs Kruger that he has cancelled Kruger's newspaper delivery, broken his radio, and cut the telephone lines, cutting Kruger off from the outside world. Hauntly then reveals himself to actually be Kruger's former research partner Dr. Otto van Shorn. Van Shorn demands to know the secrets of Kruger's room, but Kruger refuses to tell him. Unrelented, van Shorn wheels Kruger out to the cliff behind his home and threatens to roll him over the edge. Kruger gives in, and directs van Shorn to the room. Giving van Shorn the key to the room, Kruger watches as he rushes inside to see his treasures, only to find an unseen horror. However, van Shorn forgets to remove the key from the lock, and Kruger slams the door behind him, locking van Shorn inside. As van Shorn pounds on the door, screaming in terror, Kruger thinks back to the last time he saw van Shorn. He recalls that some 30 years prior, he and van Shorn created a serum in their lab, dubbed Formula-X, that they believed was the key to eternal life. Kruger rushed into town to purchase small animals to test the formula on. However, van Shorn could not wait, and decided to forcibly test the formula on Kruger's wife and children, who were residing upstairs. When Kruger returned, van Shorn had vanished, and he discovered that Formula-X did not grant eternal life, but instead disrupted the natural growth and function of body cells. After the screams stop, Kruger then breaks the fourth wall and asks the audience if they really want to know what's in the room. He relents and opens the door to reveal the monstrous, fanged shadows of his wife and children.

vincent mangano.name: Vincent Mangano
vincent mangano.origin: Vincent Mangano was a member of the Maggia crime family who helped run a drug trafficker operation. After one his men, John Bartoli, was confronted by the Punisher he had the man's house armed with explosives and after a successful deal, dropped Bartoli and his family off and then set off the explosives killing them. A month later, the Punisher tracked down one of his men Bobby Peculo, who killed himself to avoid revealing anything about Mangano and risking his family. To take out the Punisher, Mangano hired Paladin and after his first attempt failed, Mangano has Ralph Parlini released from jail to help. After this attempt failed, Mangano had Microchip kidnapped and brought to his mansion. Since Parlini had failed him, he attempted to kill Parlini's family in the same way as the Bartoli family but they were save by the Punisher and U.S.Agent. After they Punisher discovered Microchips's kidnapping they teamed up to take down Mangano. They managed to fight their way through the mansion and the Punisher killed Mangano with a grenade.

vincent martinelli.name: Vincent Martinelli
vincent martinelli.origin: A noted security specialist, Vince Martell was placed in the witness relocation plan after he testified against the mob in Philadelphia. Forced to leave his wife and under his new name "Vic Martinelli" later became Security Chief for Stark International. Martinelli has proved his worth to the company on numerous occasions with his "no-nonsense" pragmatic approach. Martinelli was pictured in public relations material at Stark International which led to the underworld to hire Blacklash to assassinate Martinelli. Assisted by Iron Man, Martinelli was able to escape from Backlash and incapacitate the villain. Martinelli continued to work for Stark International and later Stane International when it was under the auspices of Obadiah Stane. After losing his job, Martinelli fell back on his military intelligence background and eventually started working as an underground courier, transporting top-secret intel across the globe. He became involved with corrupt governments and even Hydra, at one point serving as a contractor for the terrorist organization. Martinelli's latest employee was a black market network called Source Control, which specialized in high-grade technology and weapons. When Source Control obtained the rings of the deceased Mandarin, Martinelli had a crisis of conscience and attempted to reach out to Iron Man and War Machine. After learning of Vic's actions, Source Control sent the Titanium Man after Martinelli. He brutally murdered Vic and retrieved the rings.

vincent patilio.name: Vincent Patilio
vincent patilio.origin: ===Villain=== Vincent Patilio was an inventor by trade. He spent most of his life inventing novelty items for toy companies. By his own description, Vincent Patilio was a small-time loser. He had some skills as an inventor and dreamed of making it big. But all his inventions were failures and never got past the patent office. Then he designed power-pack driven, leaping coils. They were his most successful invention, but he did not even bother with getting a patent for them. He designed a costume for himself and started a life of crime as the Leap-Frog. He was soon defeated by Daredevil. Vincent's villainous career started at an airport, where he tested his ability to leap all over the place. He prevented airplanes from taking off and was pursued by the police. He took blind man Matthew Murdock as a hostage, trying to get a breather from his pursuers. After resting for a bit, the Leap-Frog released Murdock and escaped. Vincent next wore the new Leap-Frog's Suit and decided to use it to reinvent himself as a master criminal. At nighttime, the Leap-Frog bounced his way through New York City. He decided to rob the first jewelry store that appeared in his path. He easily opened the locked door of the store, and started stealing jewels. However, this action activated the store's alarm. By coincidence, a patrolling Daredevil was standing three blocks away from the jewelry store and decided to respond to the alarm. The Leap-Frog managed to silence the alarm, but Daredevil entered the store. He attacked the Leap-Frog, but the villain effortlessly evaded the attack. He was very fast when moving, and Daredevil realized that the Leap-Frog was faster than his previous opponents. The villain also evaded the next attack of Daredevil. The hero realized that the Leap-Frog acted defensively, but had yet to make any offensive move. The Leap-Frog then started ricocheting from wall to wall, while increasing his speed. Daredevil was too slow to grab or touch him. The Leap-Frog then broke through a window and escaped into the night, while taunting the Daredevil. The following morning, at 8:30 AM, the Leap-Frog robbed a bank. His crime was reported in the radio news. The Leap-From was depicted escaping with his loot. He was amazed at how easy it was to rob the bank, and thought of ways to challenge himself. Meanwhile, Daredevil had tracked him down and prepared to ambush him. He jumped "Froggy" and got his hands around the surprised villain. Leap-Frog struggled to escape, and used the loot as a club on Daredevil's head. A dazed Daredevil let go of his opponent. The villain was leaping all around him and mocking him. Daredevil recovered and used the cable from his Billy Club to ensnare the Leap-Frog. He brought the villain crashing to the ground and started pulling him. With the Leap-Frog immobilized, Daredevil started repeatedly punching him in the face. The villain feigned surrender, but was actually playing possum. He kicked Daredevil's face. Daredevil started punching him again. The Leap-Frog tried to escape by leaping away, but Daredevil kicked one of his legs and prevented him from doing so. Daredevil then delivered a knock-out punch and send Leap-Frog flying into a nearby pool of water. Shortly after, Daredevil delivered the defeated villain to the police. Vincent next send a written message to lawyers Foggy Nelson and Matthew Murdock, asking them to defend him in court. Foggy seemed against the idea, as he wanted nothing to do with costumed super-villains. However, Matthew wanted to take the case, claiming that he found super-villains intriguing. Originally Matthew Murdock was supposed to represent Vincent in court, but he was replaced at the last moment by Foggy Nelson. Vincent attended his trial, while wearing a civilian suit. The district attorney presented, as evidence against him, the shoes of the Leap-Frog's Suit and explained how they worked. Vincent claimed never to have seen the shoes before, and never to have worn the suit. He claimed to have a severe fear of heights. Vincent next claimed that these shoes were too small for his feet, and could never fit him. The district attorney challenged him to wear the shoes, which was exactly what Vincent wanted. The shoes fit the man, and he admitted being the Leap-Frog. But then used the shoes to leap away and attempted to escape. The Leap-Frog broke through a window and discovered he had made a fatal mistake. His shoes had to be tightly fastened on his feet to work properly, but the district attorney had somehow removed the fasteners. The super-villain was falling from a great height, while one of the shoes fell away. The Leap-Frog landed on the street and was in pain. His single shoe had broken his fall and saved his life, but one of his legs was broken. Vincent heard someone calling him a fool for failing to wait for his rescue, and discovered someone towering above his body. fields.notes: Daredevil thinks that the codename Leap-Frog is "corny". While held on a choke hold by the Leap-Frog, Daredevil realized that Vincent is a strong man. The Stilt-Man has accused the Leap-Frog of being a fool, a bungler, and an amateur. Daredevil considers the Stilt-Man to be far more dangerous than the Leap-Frog. At one point, Vincent considered the Beetle to be his friend and cared for the other man's safety. It is unclear if they have kept contact with each other. As depicted in (September, 1982), Vincent Patilio has anger management problems. He feels deeply humiliated for all his past failures and partly blames "show-off" superheroes for them. He feels uncontrollable anger whenever he even sees superheroes. He has slapped his own son in anger, before even realizing that he is becoming abusive. Vincent Patilio constantly struggles with feelings of despair. Vincent Patilio spend his imprisonment in Ryker's Island.

vincent roberts.name: Vincent Roberts
vincent roberts.origin: When jungle explorer Vincent Roberts goes missing his lover, the wealthy Alice Graham, insists on going to see Swami Krishna, a supposed mystic who claims to speak to the dead, to learn if he is alive or dead. When she tells this to her friends the Human Torch and Toro, they try to caution her against going, in the event that Krishna is really a fraud, but Alice won't listen. The Torch and Toro decide the best thing they can do to avoid Alice from being bled dry by a chestier is to try and find Vincent themselves. The Torch and Toro's hunch prove right as Swami Krishina is really a fraud that uses intricate props, special effects and actors to give the illusion that he is summoning the spirits of the dead, and he is prepared and eagerly awaits to swindle Alice Graham of her fortune with his false tales of Vincent Robert's fate. When Alice pays a visit, the Swami uses his tricks to "conjuring" an image of Vincent in the jungle being felled by a poison dart being shot by a native. Convincing Alice that Vincent is dead, Alice asks the Swami to summon his spirit back so she might see him again. When she offers to pay any price for this "dangerous task", the Swami tells her to come back the next day. Meanwhile, the Human Torch and Toro arrive in Africa and track down Vincent's last known location. Asking one of the natives they learn that Vincent had been taken ill but is now on the mend. vincent rosa.name: Vincent Rosa
vincent rosa.origin: The youngest son of a local crime boss named Albert Rosa, Vincent Rosa made a habit of raping the local school girls knowing that his father's power over the people around him would ensure his safety. It wasn't until a school friend of Frank Castle's, Lauren Buvoli was given the same treatment and committed suicide, that Frank took his father's gun and set out to deal with Vincent. However, after tracking Vincent down he witnessed his long and gruesome murder at the hands of Lauren's brother, Sal Buvoli.

vincent sandhurst.name: Vincent Sandhurst
vincent sandhurst.origin: As head attorney to Cord Industries and its founder Drexel Cord, Vincent Sandhurst became more prominent in the company when Drexel Cord died, leaving his young daughter Janice Cord in charge of this significant industrial company. It was later revealed that Vincent had a disabled brother, Basil Sandhurst. Vincent felt —and was— responsible for Basil's accident which left him crippled and grotesquely disfigured. Vincent illegally took funds from Cord Industries and gave money to Basil in order for him to walk again. However, Basil used the funds and his unique genius to become the villainous "Controller". Vincent Sandhurst's circle of contemporaries shrank greatly. Drexel Cord and his daughter Janice were both deceased. His brother Basil has been in great mortal peril for most of his criminal career. Vincent was eventually dismissed from his influential position at Cord Industries. Vincent Sandhurst developed a great animosity for Tony Stark. Sandhurst assassinated The Mercenary, who was disguised as Stark at the time. In the aftermath of this assassination, Vincent Sandhurst also perished from a gunshot received by The Mercenary earlier.

vincent stegron.name: Vincent Stegron
vincent stegron.species: Human transformed by the Connors Formula into a Stegosaurus hybrid
vincent stegron.origin: ===Early Life=== Dr. Vincent Stegron was working as an assistant to Dr. Curtis Connors on a project for S.H.I.E.L.D. that used dinosaur tissue supplied by Ka-Zar from the Savage Land. ===Dinosaur Man=== Vincent became obsessed with the Lizard experiments and decided to steal the dinosaur extract. He fled to the Savage Land and ingested the Connors Formula with the Stegosaurus DNA, turning himself into a Dinosaur Man. Doc Connors contacted Spider-Man for help and he traveled to the Savage Land, teamed up with Ka-Zar, and found Stegron in full reptile mode, ruling over the Swamp Men. When Spidey and Ka-Zar beat up on his Swamp Men, Stegron escaped to New York City on a flying Ark. Stegron then led a stampede of dinosaurs down Broadway. He was stopped by Spider-Man and the Black Panther and tried to escape on a pterodactyl. Instead he was knocked into the water by Spider-Man and sank like a rock. ===Return of Stegron=== Stegron reduced his metabolism and eventually drifted to shore. He returned to Manhattan, kidnapped Billy Connors, and forced Curt Connors to work for him. He created a "retro-generation ray" that animated the dinosaur skeletons at the Natural History Museum. Under the strain of Billy's kidnapping, Curt Connors turned into the Lizard and went after Stegron. Unfortunately, Stegron chose December to start his plan and eventually succumbed to the cold weather. He slipped beneath the ice of a Central Park lake and disappeared from sight. ===The Lethal Foes=== Somehow Stegron survived, reverted to human form, and became a homeless resident of the park. In the wrong place at the wrong time, he got hit by a stray shot from a Nuclear Blaster wielded by the Vulture and was changed back into the Dinosaur Man. He returned to the Museum of Natural History, with plans to create a race of dinosaur people. but ended up in the midst of a struggle between Spider-Man and his "Lethal Foes", Doctor Octopus, Vulture, Rhino, Beetle, Boomerang, the Answer, Swarm, Strikeback, and Hardshell. Stegron tried to steal the Nuclear Blaster to create his dinosaur army, but instead got blasted into unconsciousness by Strikeback. thumb|left|Modern Stegron ===Travel to Antarctica=== Now, growing more and more bestial, Stegron's only desire was to return to his home in the Savage Land. He stowed away on a supply ship bound for Antarctica and got into a S.H.I.E.L.D. observation post where he began killing off scientists. Thunderstrike, the Black Panther and the Black Widow answered the distress call. 'Strike and the Panther released Stegron to the outside elements, and although the Dinosaur Man tried to make it to the Savage Land, he came up just short, felled by the harsh cold of Antarctica. ===Return to the Savage Land=== Stegron fell into hibernation, frozen inside a glacier. He thawed and joined the Savage Land battle between Spider-Man, Ka-Zar, Shanna the She-Devil, and the Roxxon Oil Company. When the Hulk and Chtylok the Che-K'n Kau arrived to complicate things further, Stegron opted for fighting on the side of the good guys against Roxxon, and walked off into the sunset at the end, vowing to be everybody's enemy in next time they met. ===Attempting to Resurrect the Saurians=== Stegron later discovered the subterranean home of the Saurians, who had been slain by the Dire Wraiths years prior, located beneath the San Andres Mountains. Stegron attempted to resurrect them using a scepter, but their DNA was combined with the Dire Wraiths', filling them with hatred and malice. These hybrids used the Saurian skeletons as hosts but needed living hosts which they drained of all life. Stegron attempted to return them to the dead but was unable to do so and was kept around because they needed Stegron to bring more to life. Stegron travelled the Arctic Circle where he stumbled across the 'Rock of Life', an asteroid fragment whose unique radiation sparked life and also affected the proto reptilian portions of human brains, unleashing feral and animalistic behavior. This first affected animals before spreading to 'monsters' such as Edward Whelan (Vermin) and John Jameson (Man-Wolf) as well as 'mammals' like Spider-Man and the Black Cat. Stegron planned to use this to bring down the cities of man, starting with New York City which he planned to transform and devolve but was foiled by Spider-Man. He later returned to the Savage Land which he helped Ka-Zar protect, along with many of its other denizens, from Roxxon. Captain America discovered Stegron in the subterranean tunnels after a group of environmentalists were captured by the hybrids and revealed the truth to him before Cap was possessed by the hybrid queen. Hawkeye used a sonic arrow to force the queen's symbiote off Cap and Stegron told them the hybrids were going to spill out into the world soon and kill all living beings. vincent stevens.name: Vincent Stevens
vincent stevens.origin: Almost powerless after a battle with Salome, Doctor Strange retreated to a pocket dimension and dispatched two magical constructs based upon himself: Vincent Stevens, to build a fortune to develop so-called technomagick, and 'Strange' to fight alongside the Midnight Sons and gather objects of magical power. Stevens and Strange rebelled against Doctor Strange, and Stevens was apparently destroyed, while Strange retreated to the Dark Dimension, where he merged with the rebellion's Nobel as Paradox, working beside Clea.

vincent stewart.name: Vincent Stewart
vincent stewart.origin: ===Xavier Institute=== thumb|190px|left|Redneck's old powers The young mutant called Redneck was a student of the Xavier Institute. He came from a large family in Arkansas, experienced first hand violence against mutants, and became friends with fellow student Radian. Redneck was ready to fight Cassandra Nova as she made her second assault. Instead, Redneck became mentally controlled by Nova and was forced to fight the X-Men on her behalf. Redneck and the other students were freed soon after by the Stepford Cuckoos. Some time after, Redneck joined Quentin Quire, also known as Kid Omega, and his group. This small team of mutants was dubbed the Omega Gang. As the Omega Gang later attacked a small group of humans to avenge the mutant fashion designer Jumbo Carnation, Redneck used his powers to burn one of the humans. When Kid Omega and his gang started a riot at the Xavier Institute, Redneck was stopped by Cyclops, whose optic blasts broke his nose. As his punishment for his involvement in the riot, Redneck was sent to a prison run by humans. Redneck lost his mutant powers after the event called M-Day. ===New Warriors=== thumb|190px|right|Unmasked Vincent was later offered membership in the newest incarnation of the New Warriors. After being given a flight suit and new technological weaponry based on the designs of the Beetle to replace his lost powers he adopted the code-name Skybolt, and began training with the team, which included his former Omega Gang teammates Radian, now called Phaser and Tattoo, now using the code-name Longstrike. However, on one of the team's first missions out to stop the Zodiac, Longstrike got too cocky when fighting Cancer, and was brutally killed in front of the rest of the team. Vin didn't seem too saddened by Christine's death, even criticizing her work ethic in front of her brother almost immediately after her death. Although callous and harsh, he showed a commitment to the New Warriors and their cause and continued working alongside them. However, he was later killed in action by an explosion.

As the Omega Gang later attacked a small group of humans to avenge the mutant fashion designer Jumbo Carnation, Redneck used his powers to burn one of the humans. When Kid Omega and his gang started a riot at the Xavier Institute, Redneck was stopped by Cyclops, whose optic blasts broke his nose. As his punishment for his involvement in the riot, Redneck was sent to a prison run by humans. Redneck lost his mutant powers after the event called M-Day. ===New Warriors=== thumb|190px|right|Unmasked Vincent was later offered membership in the newest incarnation of the New Warriors. After being given a flight suit and new technological weaponry based on the designs of the Beetle to replace his lost powers he adopted the code-name Skybolt, and began training with the team, which included his former Omega Gang teammates Radian, now called Phaser and Tattoo, now using the code-name Longstrike. However, on one of the team's first missions out to stop the Zodiac, Longstrike got too cocky when fighting Cancer, and was brutally killed in front of the rest of the team. Vin didn't seem too saddened by Christine's death, even criticizing her work ethic in front of her brother almost immediately after her death. Although callous and harsh, he showed a commitment to the New Warriors and their cause and continued working alongside them. However, he was later killed in action by an explosion.

vincent varl.name: Vincent Varl
vincent varl.origin: Captain America is sitting in on a practice session of his friend musician Vincent Varl who plays classical music from his Amati violin. However his promoters are not interested and tell him that he should start playing Jazz music in order to boost popularity. Vincent is reluctant to play Jazz music on his Amati due to his artistic integrity, but eventually caves. However, later that night as he is practising the new music style something causes his notes to come out all wrong. Wondering why, Vincent is shocked when a tiny Imp comes out of his violin. The Imp informs him that he refuses to allow Vincent to play Jazz music in a classical Amati violin. The Imp tells him that he was in the workshop where the Amati was originally constructed in the 16th Century. Having fallen in love with its sound the Imp took possession of it and lived inside it before others of his kind could claim it for themselves. When the Imp returns to his home, Vincent tries to tell his wife who passess off the experience as nerves. Later, Vincent and Captain America pay a visit to a psychiatrist who tells Vincent that the Imp is likely a product of his subconscious, creating a hallucination to feed his doubts about playing Jazz music. Trying to appease the Imp, Vincent meets with his manager and asks to be able to play his music solo, the manager likes the idea of an Amati being played as part of a crooning number and accepts. When Vincent puts on his show, the Imp attempts to sabotage it and is instantly distracted by the chorus girls who are dancing on stage. Still the music is altered and although both Vincent and Cap believe that he did poorly they are both surprised when his performance gets rave reviews for its "unique" sound. Even more impressive, the Imp has now grown to appreciate Jazz music -- if only for the chorus girls who dance than anything else. And so, Vincent embraces his new found fame putting on shows while the Imp tries to dance along with the ladies in his show.

vincent von doom.name: Vincent von Doom
vincent von doom.origin: In a reality where the heroes and villains involved in the conflict known as the Secret Wars never returned to Earth from the site of the Wars, Battleworld, Vincent Von Doom was the son of Doctor Doom and Enchantress. Vincent's father had apparently killed his mother at some point in his adolescence. Vincent had a half-brother, Balder, from his mother's previous relationship with Thor, who she left for Vincent's father. Inheriting his father's lust for power, Vincent eventually slew him to take his place. He then organized a group of other children of the villains involved in the Secret Wars, and clashed with the children of the heroes, while sending robots to battle the adult heroes. During the conflict, Vincent fought his half-brother, and mocked him for his inferior sorcerous abilities. Nevertheless, Vincent was defeated. To add insult to injury, Doctor Doom, having foreseen his son's treachery appeared alive and well to spirit Vincent away for punishment.

vincente cimetta.name: Vincente Cimetta
vincente cimetta.origin: Vincente was a mutant who was further mutated into pseudo-vampiric form by Emplate and made a member of his Hellions. Vincente battled Generation X alongside Gayle Edgerton, Murmur, D.O.A., and Bulwark. On the team's first strike against the young mutants, Vincente hid himself inside of a pot of soup at a restaurant. When M opened the lid to smell it, he entered her lungs and tried to suffocate her. He succeeded in knocking most of the team unconscious, but not before M let out a telepathic cry for help. Her cry was heard by Bishop of the X-Men, who came to her rescue. Oddly enough, the mutant from the future had a connection to Emplate, as a group of parasitic mutants calling themselves the Emplates plagued Bishop's future timeline. This gave him the incentive he needed to rescue the teens in danger. Vincente tried to attack Bishop in the same manner he did Generation X, but the mutant's natural ability of absorption began to digest Vincente in his mist form. He was able to escape with his life, and left with his teammates after they were beaten. Vincente returned with Emplate's gang (this time sporting new members) when the villain tried once again to reclaim Penance as his possession. Vincente had learned the ability to make his vapor form poisonous, but that didn't stop him from being beaten yet again. After his ignominious defeat, he never appeared again. His status after the depowering of the earth's mutant population has yet to be revealed.

vincente fortunato.name: Vincente Fortunato
vincente fortunato.origin: Kingpin (Wilson Fisk) once targeted Dante Rigoletto and Don Fortunato for assassination when he was attempting to complete his leadership of the criminal underworld in New York City. He succeeded in killing Rigoletto, but Fortunato was saved by Jacob Conover. When the Kingpin was absent from New York for a long period of time, Fortunato stepped into the power vacuum and, using his Hydra ties, was able to force the other crimelords, such as the Slug and Hammerhead, into accepting him as the new kingpin. His elder son, Giacomo (better known as "Jimmy-6"), was present at the meeting where Fortunato portrayed his power. Don brought out the killer Tombstone to be executed. He then brought out random civilians from each of the crimelord's territories. His plan was to have each crime-lord kill a civilian, showcasing how Fortunato would punish disobedience by civilian massacres. Jimmy 6, horrified, pulled a gun on his father in front of the crowd of people. The spectators did not intervene, wishing to see how Fortunato would handle this. Ben Reilly (then Spider-Man) intervened, however, soon joined by Daredevil. The innocent civilians were freed, but they and the heroes were cornered after being pursued by various members of the meeting. Jimmy-6 showed up in an attack helicopter, killing the pursuers and rescuing the civilians and the superheroes. Jimmy eventually reconciled with his father but extended his debt to Ben and Peter Parker. Fortunato's dominance was eventually shattered when the Kingpin returned, launching simultaneous attacks on New York's crime-lords and taking command during the confusion. The assassin Nitro attacked Fortunato on the Kingpin's orders, leaving him comatose. Jimmy Six was seen leading his organization for several months afterward. Later, the elderly Fortunato re-emerged and bought the Venom symbiote at an auction for his younger son, the awkward 18-year-old Angelo. Angelo attempted to use the suit to kill Spider-Man, but the symbiote rejected him as unworthy and allowed him to fall to his death. It was also confirmed that Jimmy-6 had somehow made peace with his Father, as Fortunato briefly referred to him as "My Beautiful Giacomo", showing no signs of ill will. With Angelo dead, Jimmy-6 is in all probability the sole heir to Fortunato's crime empire.

vincenzo cerilli.name: Vincenzo Cerilli
vincenzo cerilli.origin: Trying to stop the destruction of reality following Fixer's death by his future self, the Thunderbolts tried to identify among the people who died following the appearance of the Thunderbolts Tower to compare on their database what their true fate would have been without that event, and among the identified corpses was that of Vincenzo Cerilli who, compared with the database, resulted in having disappeared around that date, but in fact the corpse was there, so the Thunderbolts remedied this discrepancy by making the corpse of Vincenzo Cerilli and all the others who had suffered the same fate disappear.

vinlu.origin: Vinlu was a Troll. Vinlu and his wife Grimlack, the famous wand maker, ran a bazaar where they traded in the black market arcana. Despite Grimlack paying the demon Morlah for magical protection, King Ragnor and his men stormed their bazaar to steal their arcane objects using a powerful wand with which they killed Vinlu and left Grimlack for dead. Grimlack survived and went to Doctor Strange asking him to avenge her and reporting that he had heard Ragnor say he would go to the auction on Kryll City.

vinnie corbo.name: Vinnie Corbo
vinnie corbo.origin: Vinnie Corbo was a small time gang leader inNew York City, he was mostly involved in prostitution. His life changed one day one of his girls, whose street name was Toots, encountered the Beyonder, a godlike being that came to Earth to learn about human desire. Seeing that he could create gold out of thin air, Toots went to get Vinnie. When Vinnie wanted answers from the Beyonder, the entity explained what it understood as its origins at the time and how it encountered Earth, and began the Secret Wars to learn about human desire. Failing to accomplish that, the Beyonder then came to Earth. Corbo, seeing a golden opportunity, convinced the Beyonder to work for him. Taking the near omnipotent being under his wing, Corbo showed him a life of decadence. The Beyonder earned a love of fine dining and became a glutton, and was educated in sex with a room full of hookers, and was given a new wardrobe. He'd repay Vinnie for this experience by helping Vinnie enforce his rackets, cure his prostitutes of sexually transmitted diseases, and create gold to fund his empire. The Beyonder was also asked to cure Corbo's son's dyslexia, as well as reform his wife to appear as she did when Corbo first married her.
